Authors: Chen Xu, Rishi Shah, Hadas Kress-Gazit, Haruki Nishimura, Masha Itkina

Learning Expressive Humanoid Locomotion from Monocular Runway Videos for Robot Fashion Shows HumanoidEmbodied

humanoid locomotion motion retargeting sim-to-real monocular video fashion show

简要说明：本文提出了一个端到端框架，将单目视频中的走秀步态迁移到人形机器人上，使其能够稳定且富有表现力地行走。

TLDR: This paper presents an end-to-end framework to transfer expressive runway walking from monocular videos to a humanoid robot, enabling stable and stylish catwalk locomotion for fashion shows.

Abstract: Runway walking requires coordinated control of posture, stride, foot placement, and whole-body motion to effectively present clothing and convey a distinctive style. However, humanoid robots used in fashion shows typically rely on locomotion policies optimized primarily for stability and walking speed, limiting their ability to reproduce expressive, human-like runway motions. In this work, we present an end-to-end framework that transforms monocular runway videos into deployable humanoid locomotion policies through motion recovery, robot retargeting, motion correction, policy training, simulation-based evaluation, and physical deployment. We evaluate the proposed framework on the Booster K1 humanoid robot using runway-style catwalk motions. The learned policy completed every physical trial without falling, while reproducing the characteristic narrow foot placement and coordinated movement of the legs, torso, and arms. The results demonstrate that our proposed training framework enables the Booster K1 to perform stable and expressive catwalk motions, highlighting its potential for humanoid robotic applications in fashion shows and other performance-oriented scenarios.

摘要（中文）：摘要：T台行走需要对姿态、步幅、落脚位置及全身运动进行协调控制，以有效展示服装并传达独特风格。然而，用于时装秀的人形机器人通常依赖主要针对稳定性和行走速度进行优化的运动策略，这限制了其再现富有表现力、类人化T台动作的能力。在本工作中，我们提出了一种端到端框架，通过动作恢复、机器人重定向、动作修正、策略训练、基于仿真的评估及物理部署，将单目T台视频转化为可部署的人形机器人运动策略。我们使用T台风格猫步动作在Booster K1人形机器人上对所提框架进行了评估。学习得到的策略在所有物理试验中均未摔倒，同时再现了特征性的窄落脚间距以及腿、躯干和手臂的协调运动。结果表明，我们所提出的训练框架使Booster K1能够执行稳定且富有表现力的猫步动作，凸显了其在时装秀及其他表演导向场景中的人形机器人应用潜力。

Authors: Kyrylo Kolesnichenko, Irvin Steve Cardenas, Jong-Hoon Kim

AnchorReasoning: A Visual Grounding and Causal Reasoning Dataset in Long-Tail Autonomous Driving Scenarios AutonomousDriving

visually grounded chain-of-thought long-tail driving VLM reasoning trajectory prediction dataset

简要说明：提出了 AnchorReasoning，一个用于长尾自动驾驶的视觉接地推理数据集，通过 VG-CoT 监督改进 VLM 推理与轨迹预测，同时减少推理 token 和延迟。

TLDR: Introduces AnchorReasoning, a visually grounded reasoning dataset for long-tail autonomous driving with VG-CoT supervision that improves VLM reasoning and trajectory prediction while reducing reasoning tokens and latency.

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) offer a promising approach to long-tail autonomous driving, but existing driving datasets provide limited supervision for connecting decision-critical visual evidence with reasoning and planning. We introduce AnchorReasoning, a visually grounded reasoning dataset built on WOD-E2E, containing 416,119 annotated frames and 395,379 decision-critical elements across four major categories and 19 fine-grained types. Each frame is organized as a visually grounded chain-of-thought (VG-CoT) that links decision-critical element identification and localization, element attributes and implications, driving-action rationale, and action and trajectory planning. We further develop a curriculum supervised fine-tuning strategy that progressively learns these hierarchical capabilities, together with an object-size-aware grounding metric for evaluating localization quality. Experiments across eight general-purpose, embodied-AI, and AV-specific backbones show that VG-CoT supervision improves grounded reasoning and trajectory prediction. Across models, 5-s ADE and FDE decrease by 7.84 and 11.86, while RFS Frame and Cluster improve by 1.66 and 1.70. These gains are achieved with 18.5 fewer reasoning tokens and 0.32 s/frame lower inference latency on average, demonstrating the value of visually grounded, decision-focused supervision for VLM reasoning and planning in long-tail autonomous driving.

摘要（中文）：视觉语言模型（VLMs）为长尾自动驾驶提供了一种有前景的解决方案，但现有驾驶数据集在将决策关键视觉证据与推理和规划相连接方面提供的监督信息有限。我们引入了AnchorReasoning，这是一个基于WOD-E2E构建的视觉接地推理数据集，包含416,119个标注帧和395,379个决策关键要素，涵盖四个主要类别和19种细粒度类型。每个帧被组织为一条视觉接地思维链（VG-CoT），将决策关键要素的识别与定位、要素属性与含义、驾驶行为依据以及动作与轨迹规划相连接。我们进一步开发了一种课程式监督微调策略，逐步学习这些层级化能力，同时引入了一种面向对象尺寸的接地度量指标来评估定位质量。在八个通用、具身AI及自动驾驶专用骨干模型上的实验表明，VG-CoT监督提升了接地推理和轨迹预测性能。在各模型中，5秒ADE和FDE分别降低了7.84和11.86，而RFS Frame和Cluster分别提升了1.66和1.70。这些性能提升平均仅需减少18.5个推理令牌和0.32秒/帧的推理延迟，充分证明了视觉接地、决策聚焦的监督方式对VLM在长尾自动驾驶中推理与规划能力的价值。

Authors: Zhipeng Bao, Wenjie Zhao, Tianle Zhu, Haohua Que, Chence Yang, Geng Yuan, Qianwen Li

Where Should I Join? Robot Group Joining via Language-Guided Goal Prediction VLN

language-grounded goal prediction social navigation group joining energy-orientation map

简要说明：本文提出了一种语言引导的机器人加入群体方法，通过递归谱划分和语言条件图像-几何模型定位目标群体，并预测符合社交规范的加入姿态，在真实机器人上得到验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces a language-guided robot group joining method that predicts socially compliant joining poses by grounding target groups via recursive spectral partitioning and a language-conditioned image-geometry model, validated in real-robot experiments.

Abstract: Social navigation typically assumes a specified goal and focuses on reaching it while respecting social conventions, whereas robot group joining requires predicting where to join based on the group's real-time activity and formation. This is a highly semantic task, yet an important capability for applications such as robotic guide dogs and autonomous mobility scooters. We formulate language-grounded robot group joining: given an observation and a natural-language description of a target group, the robot identifies the relevant group members and predicts socially compliant joining poses. For grounding, we generate structured candidate subsets through recursive spectral partitioning and rank them with a language-conditioned image--geometry model. Given the grounded group, a goal predictor leverages human-formation priors to produce a multimodal energy--orientation map over feasible robot poses. Experiments on conversations, queues, and audiences across varying group sizes, crowd densities, and visual ambiguities show that our method achieves competitive grounding accuracy with sub-second inference and outperforms all baselines in joining-pose prediction. Real-robot experiments further demonstrate group joining in both static and dynamically changing interactions.

摘要（中文）：社交导航通常假定存在一个明确目标，并侧重于在遵循社会规范的前提下到达该目标，而机器人加入群体则要求根据群体的实时活动与队形预测加入位置。这是一项高度语义化的任务，但对于导盲机器人和自主移动代步车等应用而言却是一项重要能力。我们提出了基于语言引导的机器人群体加入方法：给定一段观测信息以及关于目标群体的自然语言描述，机器人识别相关群体成员，并预测符合社交规范的加入姿态。为实现语言 grounding，我们通过递归谱划分生成结构化候选子集，并使用语言条件化的图像—几何模型对其进行排序。在确定目标群体后，一个目标预测器利用人类队形先验，生成关于可行机器人姿态的多模态能量—方向图。我们在不同群体规模、人群密度和视觉模糊条件下的对话、队列和观众场景中进行了实验，结果表明，我们的方法在 grounding 准确率上具有竞争力，推理时间低于秒级，并且在加入姿态预测方面优于所有基线方法。真实机器人实验进一步验证了该方法在静态和动态变化的交互场景中均能实现群体加入。

Authors: Zilin Fang, Zishuo Wang, Gim Hee Lee, David Hsu

Frozen Flows Forget: Diagnosing and Restoring Lost Motion in a Latent-flow World Model WorldModel

latent world model flow matching motion restoration decode-augmented training manipulation

简要说明：本文发现，在冻结的自监督表示上训练的潜在流世界模型会丢失对操作至关重要的运动特性，并提出了一种解码增强的展开训练（DART）方法，在保持表示冻结的同时恢复运动，提高预测质量和时间结构。

TLDR: The paper identifies that latent-flow world models trained with frozen self-supervised representations lose motion crucial for manipulation, and proposes Decode-augmented Rollout Training (DART) to restore motion while keeping the representation frozen, improving prediction quality and temporal structure.

Abstract: Latent world models that integrate a flow in a frozen self supervised latent space train stably and cheaply, yet silently lose the property manipulation depends on most: motion. The pretrained flow never moves the manipulated object; retraining it with latent-only losses only trades stillness for teleport-like motion. We trace the failure to the training signal, not the representation: anchor-sparse, latent-only supervision never says where along the horizon change belongs. Decode-augmented rollout training (DART) repairs this while keeping the representation frozen, retraining only the flow with decode-path supervision. DART outperforms its latent only parent on the full protocol, restores the temporal structure of motion, and re-couples predicted motion to the scene; at larger scale it further improves prediction quality, closing nearly half the remaining gap to an oracle-informed interpolation reference. Finally, we report an unexpected finding about evaluation: pixel error alone rewards frozen predictions.

摘要（中文）：潜在世界模型在冻结的自监督潜在空间中整合流，训练稳定且成本低廉，但悄然丢失了属性操作所依赖的最关键部分：运动。预训练流从未移动被操作的对象；仅使用潜在损失对其进行重训练，只会将静止状态转变为瞬间移动般的跳跃。我们将失败归因于训练信号，而非表示本身：锚点稀疏、仅基于潜在空间的监督从未指明变化在时间跨度中的归属位置。解码增强展开训练（DART）在不冻结表示的前提下修复了这一问题，仅通过解码路径监督重训练流。DART 在完整协议上优于其仅基于潜在空间的模型，恢复了运动的时间结构，并将预测运动重新耦合到场景中；在更大规模上，它进一步提升了预测质量，使与神谕式插值参考之间的剩余差距缩小了近一半。最后，我们报告了一个关于评估的意外发现：仅凭像素误差会偏向静止预测。

Authors: Xiwen Chen, Rigaudiere Z. Li, Zhiruo Zhou, Xiaojun Zhu, Houde Liu

ForgetMimic: Motion Unlearning for Reinforcement Learning Humanoid Control HumanoidEmbodied

motion unlearning humanoid control reinforcement learning policy editing locomotion

简要说明：ForgetMimic 提出了一种面向物理人形机器人控制策略的运动级遗忘方法，能在保留其余运动性能的同时，移除指定运动（如恶意或受版权保护的运动），并在 Unitree G1 和 H2 上通过 12 种运动进行了验证。

TLDR: ForgetMimic introduces a motion-level unlearning method for physical humanoid control policies trained via reinforcement learning, enabling the removal of specific motions (e.g., malicious or copyrighted) while preserving the performance of all other motions. The method is validated on Unitree G1 and H2 humanoid robots across 12 diverse motions.

Abstract: Humanoid control, leveraging human demonstrations, has achieved diverse, agile, and natural locomotion behaviors through reinforcement learning (RL). While this paradigm has yielded remarkable performance in physical humanoid control, how to eliminate specific motions from learned policies remains insufficiently explored. Addressing this issue is motivated by pressing safety and privacy concerns: the removal of malicious, poisoned, or suboptimal motions, as well as copyright-protected motions subject to the right to be forgotten under regulations such as the GDPR, is of critical importance. To this end, we propose {ForgetMimic}, the first motion-level unlearning method designed specifically for physical-world humanoid control. The core idea of ForgetMimic is as follows: given a policy $π_θ$ trained on $N$ motions, our method degrades performance on a target subset of $K$ motions while preserving the effectiveness of the remaining $N-K$ motions. Furthermore, we identify and resolve two key training mechanisms in robot control that lead to unlearning failure. We conduct extensive experiments on the Unitree G1 and H2 humanoid robots across 12 motions, including Dance, Fight, Flip, and others. Experimental results demonstrate that ForgetMimic effectively eliminates memory of designated motions while maintaining the normal operation of all other motions.

摘要（中文）：类人控制借助人类示范，通过强化学习（RL）已实现了多样化、敏捷且自然的运动行为。尽管这一范式在物理类人控制中取得了显著性能，但如何从已学习的策略中消除特定动作仍未得到充分探索。解决这一问题源于迫切的安全与隐私关切：移除恶意、受污染或次优动作，以及受GDPR等法规中“被遗忘权”约束的受版权保护动作，具有至关重要的意义。为此，我们提出了{ForgetMimic}，这是首个专门针对物理世界类人控制的动作级遗忘方法。ForgetMimic的核心思想如下：给定一个在$N$个动作上训练的策略$π_θ$，我们的方法在目标子集$K$个动作上降低性能，同时保持其余$N-K$个动作的有效性。此外，我们识别并解决了机器人控制中导致遗忘失败的两个关键训练机制。我们在Unitree G1和H2类人机器人上，对包括舞蹈、格斗、翻转等在内的12种动作进行了广泛实验。实验结果表明，ForgetMimic能有效消除对指定动作的记忆，同时保持所有其他动作的正常运行。

Authors: Xukun Luan, Zhongxiang Lei, Chen Gong, Shaowei Li, Yuanguo Bi, Jinyan Liu

LEAP-CBF: A Safety Filter for Uncertain Systems with Least-Effort Adversarial Potentials Locomotion

control barrier functions safety filter robust control deep reinforcement learning quadruped

简要说明：本文提出LEAP，一种用于存在扰动的控制系统的安全证书，用于构建鲁棒安全滤波器，并在四足机器人和四旋翼机器人上进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces LEAP, a safety certificate for control systems under disturbances, used to construct robust safety filters and validated on quadruped and quadrotor robots.

Abstract: Control barrier functions (CBF) are a popular safety filter to ensure safety for nonlinear dynamical systems. However, when the system is subject to uncertainties and disturbances, this requires the use of robust variants of CBFs, which can be difficult to construct and can be overly conservative, especially for high-dimensional systems under input constraints. In this work, we propose a new approach to solve these challenges by introducing Least-Effort Adversarial Potentials (LEAP), a certificate that quantifies the robustness of a given state against disturbances in terms of the effort required by the disturbance to cause failure. We show that LEAP is a CBF for the undisturbed system, but can also be used to construct a safety filter that is robust to disturbances whose cumulative effort is bounded. We propose a method for constructing LEAPs with on-policy deep reinforcement learning. Next, we demonstrate LEAPs in simulation on a variety of multi-agent systems with disturbances and uncertainties. Finally, hardware experiments on a quadruped and quadrotors validate that LEAPs are well suited to tackle the disturbances and uncertainties from real-world robotic systems.

摘要（中文）：控制屏障函数（CBF）作为一种常用的安全滤波器，用于确保非线性动态系统的安全性。然而，当系统受到不确定性和扰动影响时，需要采用CBF的鲁棒变体，这类变体构造困难且可能过于保守，尤其是在输入约束下的高维系统中。本文提出了一种新的方法来解决这些挑战，引入最小努力对抗势能（LEAP）——一种证书，用以根据扰动导致系统失效所需的努力程度，量化给定状态对扰动的鲁棒性。我们证明LEAP对于无扰动系统而言是一个CBF，同时也可用于构建对累积努力有界的扰动具有鲁棒性的安全滤波器。我们提出了一种利用在线策略深度强化学习构建LEAP的方法。随后，我们在多种具有扰动和不确定性的多智能体系统仿真中展示了LEAP的应用。最后，在四足机器人和四旋翼飞行器上开展的硬件实验验证了LEAP能够有效应对真实机器人系统中的扰动与不确定性。

Authors: Oswin So, Eric Yu, Chuchu Fan

Motoneuron-Inspired Sampling for Model Predictive Path Integral Control Locomotion

Model Predictive Path Integral motoneuron-inspired structured sampling MPPI control MuJoCo Ant

简要说明：Spike-MPPI 提出了一种受运动神经元启发的采样提案用于 MPPI 控制，在 MuJoCo Ant 模型上展示了相比高斯采样更平滑的控制效果，并分析了二阶频谱结构的作用。

TLDR: Spike-MPPI introduces a motoneuron-inspired sampling proposal for MPPI control, demonstrating improved control smoothness on MuJoCo Ant models compared to Gaussian sampling, and analyzing the role of second-order spectral structure.

Abstract: Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control relies on stochastic trajectory sampling, and its performance under limited rollout budgets depends strongly on the structure of the proposal distribution. Standard implementations commonly perturb control sequences with Gaussian noise, despite growing evidence that temporally correlated and structured sampling can improve finite-budget control. We introduce Spike-MPPI, a motoneuron-inspired proposal that generates temporally structured perturbations through a simplified model of motoneuron dynamics. The proposal is evaluated within a common MPPI framework on torque-actuated and antagonistically actuated MuJoCo Ant models against standard Gaussian sampling and spectrum-matched Gaussian controls. Results show that structured sampling substantially improves executed-control smoothness, while its effect on task performance depends on rollout condition and robot actuation. Spectrum matching reproduces a substantial part of the observed behavior, while the full Spike proposal retains additional effects beyond second-order spectral structure. These results support treating proposal design as a combination of second-order spectral structure and higher-order statistical organization.

摘要（中文）：模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制依赖于随机轨迹采样，在有限 rollout 预算下，其性能在很大程度上取决于提议分布的结构。标准实现通常使用高斯噪声扰动控制序列，尽管越来越多的证据表明，时间相关且结构化的采样能够改善有限预算下的控制效果。我们提出了 Spike-MPPI，一种受运动神经元启发的提议方法，通过运动神经元动力学的简化模型生成时间结构化扰动。该提议在统一的 MPPI 框架下，针对力矩驱动和拮抗驱动的 MuJoCo Ant 模型进行了评估，并与标准高斯采样和频谱匹配的高斯控制进行了比较。结果表明，结构化采样显著改善了执行控制的平滑性，而其对任务性能的影响则取决于 rollout 条件和机器人驱动方式。频谱匹配再现了所观察行为的大部分，而完整的 Spike 提议在二阶频谱结构之外还保留了额外的效应。这些结果支持将提议设计视为二阶频谱结构与高阶统计组织的结合。

Authors: Alexis Poignant, Jan Babič

VGM-VS: Rethinking Visual Geometry Model for High-Precision Visual Servoing Manipulation

visual servoing visual geometry model pose-based visual servoing metric adaptation assembly tasks

简要说明：本文提出 VGM-VS，一种利用预训练前馈视觉几何模型估计相对相机位姿并将其应用于闭环 PBVS 方案的视觉伺服方法，通过场景特定的度量自适应实现真实世界高精度装配任务。

TLDR: This paper presents VGM-VS, a visual servoing method that leverages a pretrained feed-forward visual geometry model to estimate relative camera poses and applies them in a closed-loop PBVS scheme, with a scene-specific metric adaptation for real-world high-precision assembly tasks.

Abstract: We present VGM-VS, a visual servoing method built on a pretrained feed-forward visual geometry model. Given the current view and a reference image captured at the target configuration, we estimate the relative camera pose with a visual geometry model and apply it iteratively as the pose increment of a closed-loop pose-based visual servoing (PBVS) scheme. The geometry-aware representation acquired from large-scale pretraining keeps this estimate reliable when the target is occluded, weakly textured, or covers only a small part of the image. However, the scale ambiguity inherent to these models leaves the predicted translation defined up to an unknown scale, while the pose increment must be metric for robot control. We close this gap with a scene-specific metric adaptation: the robot autonomously records image--pose pairs along a predefined motion starting from the target pose, and we fine-tune the camera head on these data, jointly learning the hand--eye transform and thus removing the need for a dedicated calibration process. We evaluate our method on three real-world assembly tasks with demanding tolerances: USB-C cable picking, cable insertion, and RAM insertion. Running in real time at 30Hz, VGM-VS converges to submillimeter terminal accuracy on the cable tasks, and reaches success rates of 90--100\% when the target is moved during servoing. It converges in all trials under initial displacements of up to 30cm from the reference pose and with 50\% of the target object occluded, outperforming the compared visual servoing baselines.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了VGM-VS，一种基于预训练前馈视觉几何模型的视觉伺服方法。给定当前视图以及目标配置下拍摄的参考图像，我们利用视觉几何模型估计相对相机位姿，并将其作为闭环基于位姿的视觉伺服（PBVS）方案的位姿增量进行迭代应用。从大规模预训练中获得的几何感知表示确保了在目标被遮挡、纹理较弱或仅覆盖图像小部分区域时，该估计依然可靠。然而，这类模型固有的尺度模糊性导致预测的平移量仅能确定到未知尺度，而机器人控制所需的位姿增量必须是公制量纲。我们通过场景特定的公制适配弥补了这一差距：机器人沿从目标位姿开始的预定运动自主记录图像-位姿对，并在这些数据上对相机头部进行微调，同时联合学习手眼变换，从而无需专门的外部标定过程。我们在三项具有高装配公差要求的真实装配任务上评估了该方法：USB-C线缆拾取、线缆插入和内存条插入。VGM-VS以30Hz频率实时运行，在线缆任务中收敛至亚毫米级终端精度，并在目标在伺服过程中被移动时达到90–100%的成功率。在参考位姿初始偏差高达30cm且目标物体50%被遮挡的情况下，该方法在所有试验中均能收敛，优于所对比的视觉伺服基线方法。

Authors: Yimin Pan, Sen Wang, You Zhou, Jianfeng Gao, Pengbo Sun, Ahmed M. Naguib, Zoltan-Csaba Marton

Contact-Implicit Stein Projected ADMM for Discovery of Diverse Contact-Rich Manipulation Strategies Manipulation

contact-implicit trajectory optimization diverse strategies Stein variational inference ADMM contact-rich manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了一种结合共识ADMM与Stein变分推断的接触隐式轨迹优化求解器，用于发现多样化的接触丰富操作策略，并在推、抓取和交接任务中展示了比现有求解器更好的接触模式覆盖。

TLDR: This paper proposes a contact-implicit trajectory optimization solver that combines Consensus ADMM with Stein variational inference to discover a diverse set of contact-rich manipulation strategies, demonstrating improved coverage of contact modes over existing solvers in pushing, grasping, and handover tasks.

Abstract: Contact-implicit trajectory optimization formulates contact-rich manipulation as a single constrained program; however, that single program run collapses onto one local optimum out of many equally valid contact modes, grasps, or push directions. As a consequence, the resulting manipulation strategy is reluctant to change and sensitive to initialization. In order to promote robust manipulation, this paper investigates how contact-implicit solvers can discover diverse contact-rich strategies. Our approach derives a variation of Consensus Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) combined with Stein variational inference methods to output a set of distinct contact-rich solutions. We find that applying the Stein repulsive force to ADMM's split variable (rather than its primal form) allows for effective coverage over the set of feasible contact strategies without prematurely stalling the solver. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on a variety of contact-rich manipulation tasks, including pushing, grasping, and multi-robot handover. Last, we find the proposed solver is simpler in form and capable of discovering unique contact modes when compared with existing solvers. Videos and code with examples are found in https://anon-website-submission.github.io/stein-admm-website/.

摘要（中文）：接触隐式轨迹优化将接触丰富的操作问题形式化为单一约束程序；然而，该单一程序运行最终收敛到众多同样有效的接触模式、抓取方式或推动方向中的一个局部最优解。因此，所得操作策略难以改变，且对初始值高度敏感。为促进鲁棒操作，本文研究了接触隐式求解器如何发现多样化的接触丰富策略。我们的方法推导出共识交替方向乘子法（ADMM）的一种变体，并结合斯坦因变分推断方法，输出一组不同的接触丰富解。我们发现，将斯坦因排斥力作用于ADMM的分离变量（而非其原始形式），能够在不过早停滞求解器的情况下，有效覆盖可行的接触策略集合。我们在多种接触丰富的操作任务上验证了该方法的有效性，包括推动、抓取和多机器人交接。最后，我们发现与现有求解器相比，所提出的求解器形式更简洁，且能够发现独特的接触模式。相关视频和代码示例见 https://anon-website-submission.github.io/stein-admm-website/。

Authors: Hrishikesh Sathyanarayan, Christian Hughes, Ian Abraham

Controlling Collectives of AI Agents in Reasoning Space with Spatial Transformers Other

multi-robot spatial transformer feedback control collective intelligence language model

简要说明：COMPASS 是一种可扩展的去中心化多机器人架构，利用空间变换器在本地生成推理反馈，以控制大规模语言模型驱动的机器人群体，实现协同编队和对更大规模及新指令的零样本泛化。

TLDR: COMPASS is a scalable, decentralized multi-robot architecture that uses spatial transformers to generate local reasoning feedback for controlling large collectives of language-model-driven robots, achieving cohesive flocking and zero-shot generalization to larger scales and new commands.

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) introduce an exciting new paradigm for planning and navigation in robotics, but fail on even simple multi-robot tasks as team sizes grow. We propose COMPASS, a scalable, decentralized multi-robot architecture for controlling large collectives of agentic robots with reasoning space feedback control. Feedback is generated locally on each robot by a spatial transformer which aggregates multi-hop messages across the fleet into a learned feedback token. Our experiments find that collectives of language models demonstrate performance gains from structured diversity of the input command, which can cancel biases; an advantage that is held across scale. Compared against a centralized frontier LLM policy and a language-only communication ablation, we find that the coupled design of COMPASS decisively produces cohesive flocking formations that accurately fly the commanded intent. We show that reasoning feedback works best when composed with a compact learned token. Our ablations show that hand engineered feedback with raw state appearing in the language channel obliterates cohesion. COMPASS generalizes zero-shot to unseen instructions of ambiguous meaning while commanding flocks up to 16 times its training scale, flying up to 1024 robots under natural language commands.

摘要（中文）：大型语言模型（LLMs）为机器人领域的规划与导航引入了一种令人兴奋的新范式，但随着团队规模的扩大，即使在简单的多机器人任务中，它们也会失效。我们提出了COMPASS，一种可扩展的、去中心化的多机器人架构，用于通过推理空间反馈控制来控制大规模智能体机器人群体。每个机器人通过一个空间变换器在本地生成反馈，该变换器将跨机群的多跳消息聚合为一个学习得到的反馈令牌。我们的实验发现，语言模型群体在输入命令的结构化多样性下展现出性能提升，这种多样性能够抵消偏差；这一优势在不同规模下均保持一致。与集中式前沿LLM策略及仅语言通信的消融实验相比，我们发现COMPASS的耦合设计决定性地产生了紧密的编队飞行模式，能够准确执行所下达的意图。我们进一步表明，当推理反馈与紧凑的学习令牌相结合时效果最佳。我们的消融实验显示，在语言通道中直接出现原始状态的人工设计反馈会彻底破坏群体凝聚力。COMPASS能够零样本泛化到含义模糊的未见指令，同时指挥比其训练规模大16倍的群体，在自然语言指令下实现多达1024个机器人的编队飞行。

Authors: Frederic Vatnsdal, Roshan Gopal, Romina Garcia Camargo, Vijay Kumar, Alejandro Ribeiro

VLMs Can Describe, But Not Measure: Object-Centric Scene Understanding for Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

object-centric representation RGB-D perception vision-language models robotic manipulation scene understanding

简要说明：本文提出了一种模块化感知框架，将VLM标注与单次RGB-D观测的深度信息结合，构建任务无关的物体中心场景表示，在保持语义理解的同时提升机器人操作的度量精度。

TLDR: This paper presents a modular perception framework that combines VLM annotations with depth data from single RGB-D observations to build task-independent object-centric scene representations, improving metric accuracy for robotic manipulation while retaining semantic understanding.

Abstract: Robotic operation in previously unseen environments requires both semantic understanding and reliable metric information. While vision--language models (VLMs) provide strong semantic capabilities, their geometric estimates remain less reliable. In this paper, we propose a VLM-driven, modular perception framework for scene understanding using off-the-shelf approaches. Starting from a single RGB-D observation, the scene is segmented into object-level regions, annotated by a VLM, and grounded with depth information to construct a task-independent object-centric representation. Experiments on 151 tabletop scenes show that the proposed decomposition preserves strong semantic performance while substantially improving localization and depth estimation over direct VLM inference. The resulting representation is also integrated with a task-planning framework for robotic execution.

摘要（中文）：在以往未见环境中进行机器人操作，既需要对场景的语义理解，也需要可靠的度量信息。尽管视觉-语言模型（VLMs）提供了强大的语义能力，但其几何估计的可靠性仍有不足。本文提出了一种基于VLM驱动的模块化感知框架，利用现成方法实现场景理解。从单一RGB-D观测出发，将场景分割为对象级区域，由VLM进行标注，并结合深度信息构建任务无关的对象中心化表示。在151个桌面场景上的实验表明，所提出的分解方法在显著提升定位与深度估计精度的同时，保持了较强的语义性能。该表示还进一步与任务规划框架集成，用于机器人执行。

Authors: Enrico Saccon, Tommaso Faraci, Iñigo De La Ossa Zarzuelo, Luigi Palopoli, Marco Roveri, Matteo Saveriano

DEAL-Grasp: Decoupled Alignment Representation for Geometry-Aware Dexterous Grasp Generation Manipulation

dexterous grasp synthesis flow matching Procrustes alignment hand-object interaction geometry-aware generation

简要说明：DEAL-Grasp 提出了一种解耦对齐表示用于灵巧抓取生成，利用异构状态流匹配生成几何感知的手物交互，无需测试时优化，在 MultiDex 和 RealDex 基准上实现了高成功率和低延迟。

TLDR: DEAL-Grasp introduces a decoupled alignment representation for dexterous grasp synthesis, using heterogeneous-state flow matching to generate geometry-aware hand-object interactions without test-time optimization, achieving high success rates and low latency on MultiDex and RealDex benchmarks.

Abstract: Synthesizing realistic articulated hand-object interactions is a fundamental problem in virtual reality, embodied intelligence, and digital human applications. Existing methods for dexterous grasp synthesis typically regress or denoise poses in a joint space that couples global rigid motion with local articulation, which often yields unstable samples and physically implausible contacts. We introduce DEAL-Grasp, built upon the Decoupled Alignment (DEAL) representation, which reformulates grasp synthesis as alignment-space generation: the interaction state comprises task-space geometric anchors and articulation parameters, from which the rigid transform is recovered via closed-form Procrustes alignment while preserving local articulation. On this mixed state, we model grasp generation using heterogeneous-state flow matching with component-wise vector fields, incorporating time-adaptive physical regularization during training. At inference, grasps are synthesized solely by integrating the learned vector field, without test-time optimization or auxiliary physical guidance. Across MultiDex and zero-shot RealDex benchmarks, DEAL-Grasp attains high force-perturbation success rates alongside minimal penetration and high diversity of generated grasps, while substantially reducing native inference latency compared to optimization-heavy baselines. The project page is available at https://wmtlab.github.io/DEAL-Grasp/.

摘要（中文）：合成逼真的关节手-物体交互是虚拟现实、具身智能和数字人应用中的基础问题。现有的灵巧抓取合成方法通常在高维联合空间中对姿态进行回归或去噪，该空间将全局刚体运动与局部关节运动耦合在一起，往往导致样本不稳定且物理接触不真实。我们提出了DEAL-Grasp，基于解耦对齐（Decoupled Alignment, DEAL）表示，将抓取合成重新定义为对齐空间生成问题：交互状态由任务空间中的几何锚点和关节参数组成，通过闭式Procrustes对齐恢复刚体变换，同时保持局部关节运动不变。在此混合状态上，我们采用异质状态流匹配方法建模抓取生成，使用逐分量的向量场，并在训练过程中加入时间自适应的物理正则化。在推理阶段，仅通过积分学习到的向量场即可合成抓取，无需测试时优化或辅助物理引导。在MultiDex和零样本RealDex基准上，DEAL-Grasp在力扰动下实现了高成功率，同时具有极低的穿透深度和高多样性生成抓取，并且与依赖大量优化的基线方法相比，显著降低了原生推理延迟。项目页面见 https://wmtlab.github.io/DEAL-Grasp/。

Authors: Fuqiang Zhao, Qian Liu

Distillation for Efficient Multitask Manipulation Policies via Conditional Flow Matching Manipulation

Conditional Flow Matching Distillation Multi-Task Learning Robot Manipulation Velocity Fields

简要说明：本文提出将单任务条件流匹配（CFM）专家模型的知识蒸馏到共享的多任务操作策略中，通过迁移学习到的速度场，并结合原始CFM目标以保持对示范的保真度，在RLBench上提升了多任务策略性能，同时保持模型大小不变。

TLDR: This paper proposes distilling knowledge from single-task Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) experts into a shared multi-task manipulation policy by transferring learned velocity fields, combining this with the original CFM objective to improve multi-task performance on RLBench without increasing model size.

Abstract: Advances in generative modeling have recently been extensively employed in robotics for policy learning. In particular, Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) trained with expert demonstrations has been shown to outperform existing methods on robot manipulation benchmarks. While prior work has mainly focused on single-task settings, we study the problem from a multi-task perspective, as training independent models for each task is computationally expensive. Multi-Task policy learning comes with its own set of challenges, as naively training on a concatenated dataset of demonstrations would either require increased model capacity to accommodate the added complexity or result in drops in performance. We propose to distill knowledge from single-task CFM experts into a shared multi-task policy by transferring their learned velocity fields. We combine this distillation signal with the original CFM objective to retain fidelity to the demonstrations. Experiments on RLBench show that our approach improves multi-task policy performance over naive training while maintaining a fixed model size.

摘要（中文）：生成建模的进展近来已被广泛用于机器人策略学习。特别是，使用专家示范训练的条件流匹配（CFM）已被证明在机器人操作基准测试中优于现有方法。虽然以往的研究主要聚焦于单任务场景，我们从多任务角度研究该问题，因为为每个任务独立训练模型在计算上代价高昂。多任务策略学习本身面临一系列挑战，因为简单地在拼接的示范数据集上训练要么需要更大的模型容量以应对增加的复杂度，要么会导致性能下降。我们提出将单任务CFM专家模型的知识提炼到共享的多任务策略中，通过迁移其学习到的速度场来实现。我们将这种蒸馏信号与原始CFM目标相结合，以保持对示范数据的忠实度。在RLBench上的实验表明，我们的方法在保持固定模型规模的同时，相比简单训练提升了多任务策略的性能。

Authors: Shreya Deshmukh, Imen Mahdi, Nick Heppert, Abhinav Valada

SlackDrive: Reclaiming Runtime Slack for Adaptive Driving Inference AutonomousDriving

world-action model latency adaptation runtime slack compute allocation autonomous driving

简要说明：SlackDrive 提出了一种预推理计算分配器，利用已实现的延迟为驾驶世界动作模型动态选择每个控制步骤的计算预算，在延迟约束下提升了闭环驾驶指标。

TLDR: SlackDrive introduces a pre-inference compute allocator for driving world-action models that reuses realized latency to dynamically select compute budgets per control step, improving latency-constrained closed-loop driving metrics.

Abstract: Driving world-action models improve planning by coupling multimodal reasoning with future prediction, but their growing inference cost increasingly conflicts with the real-time latency requirements of vehicle control. Existing acceleration methods reduce tokens, layers, or sampling steps with policies selected prior to deployment, yet leave residual runtime variation largely unexploited after offline profiling and static scheduling on shared onboard compute. We observe that the largest admissible compute budget varies systematically with the residual runtime state, while recent realized latency provides a direct signal of the available compute slack. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{SlackDrive}, a pre-inference compute allocator that reuses realized latency to select the compute budget of each control step before model execution. SlackDrive profiles the latency and planning utility of a small discrete budget set once, estimates online compute state from completed forwards, and selects the highest-utility budget predicted to remain within the admissible latency envelope, complementing existing profiling and resource scheduling while preserving the driving backbone and its compute actuator. On NAVSIM v2 with DriveDreamer-Policy, SlackDrive improves latency-constrained EPDMS by $21.7\%$ over the strongest baseline under a stringent latency regime, while the full-budget model and preconfigured token-pruning baselines exceed the admissible latency envelope under runtime contention.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 驾驶世界行动模型通过将多模态推理与未来预测相结合来提升规划能力，但其日益增长的推理成本与车辆控制的实时延迟要求之间的矛盾愈发突出。现有加速方法在部署前通过预设策略减少token、层数或采样步数，然而在共享车载计算平台上完成离线性能剖析和静态调度后，仍留下了大量未利用的运行时动态变化空间。我们观察到，最大允许的计算预算随剩余运行时状态系统性地变化，而最近一次实际延迟则直接反映了可用计算余量。基于这一观察，我们提出\textbf{SlackDrive}，一种推理前计算分配器，它在模型执行前复用实际延迟来选择每个控制步骤的计算预算。SlackDrive对小型离散预算集合的延迟和规划效用进行一次离线性能剖析，根据已完成的前向传播估计在线计算状态，并选择预测能在允许延迟包络内运行的最高效用预算，从而在保留驾驶主干网络及其计算执行器的同时，补充现有的性能剖析和资源调度方法。在NAVSIM v2上使用DriveDreamer-Policy，SlackDrive在严格延迟约束下比最强基线提升了$21.7\%$的延迟受限EPDMS，而全预算模型和预配置的token剪枝基线在运行时资源竞争下则超出允许的延迟包络。

Authors: Xiaohuan Pei, Hengguang Zhou, Yuanhao Ban, Justin Cui, Jiaqi Feng, Haoyu Xie, Tao Huang, Pichao Wang, Yanchao Yang, Cho-Jui Hsieh

Learning a Speed-adaptive Hip Exoskeleton Control Policy Via Sim-to-real Reinforcement Learning Locomotion

sim-to-real RL hip exoskeleton preference learning personalized assistance walking speed

简要说明：该论文提出了一种结合仿真到现实强化学习与在线偏好学习的框架，用于在不同行走速度下个性化髋部外骨骼控制策略，减少了人机循环评估次数。

TLDR: This paper presents a framework that combines sim-to-real reinforcement learning with online preference learning to personalize a hip exoskeleton control policy across varying walking speeds, reducing human-in-the-loop evaluations.

Abstract: Providing personalized exoskeleton assistance across varying walking speeds remains challenging. Existing online optimization methods are sample-inefficient, requiring extensive human-in-the-loop (HIL) evaluations to optimize the entire assistive torque profile. Sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising alternative but cannot directly account for individual user preferences. We propose a framework integrating sim-to-real RL with online preference learning for personalized exoskeleton assistance. Specifically, assistance timing is learned in simulation by training RL policies with human musculoskeletal models across varying walking speeds. The learned policies are then distilled and deployed on a physical hip exoskeleton using onboard sensory observations. Gaussian-process-based preference learning further personalizes the assistance magnitude through pairwise user comparisons. By decoupling assistance timing learning in simulation from magnitude optimization in real-world experiments, our framework substantially reduces the online optimization space. Human-subject experiments demonstrate efficient identification of personalized assistive torque profiles across varying walking speeds with fewer real-world evaluations.

摘要（中文）：提供个性化外骨骼辅助以适配不同行走速度仍具挑战性。现有在线优化方法样本效率较低，需大量人机交互评估来优化完整的辅助力矩曲线。仿真到现实强化学习提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但无法直接考虑个体用户偏好。我们提出一个将仿真到现实强化学习与在线偏好学习相结合以实现个性化外骨骼辅助的框架。具体而言，辅助时机通过在仿真中利用人体肌肉骨骼模型训练强化学习策略来学习，覆盖不同行走速度。学习到的策略随后被提取并部署到物理髋部外骨骼上，利用机载感官观测进行控制。基于高斯过程的偏好学习通过成对用户比较进一步个性化辅助幅度。通过在仿真中解耦辅助时机学习与实物实验中的幅度优化，我们的框架显著缩减了在线优化空间。受试者实验表明，该方法能够以更少的实物评估次数高效识别不同行走速度下的个性化辅助力矩曲线。

Authors: Bin Li, Zhimin Hou, Jiacheng Hou, Zenian Liang, Tong Wu, Teng Ma, Chenglong Fu

CoRelNav: Collaborative Relational Navigation for Multi-Robot Spatially Constrained Semantic Navigation VLN

multi-robot collaboration semantic navigation relational verification exploration utility photorealistic simulation

简要说明：CoRelNav 提出了一种多机器人协作框架，用于空间约束下的语义导航，将任务条件探索与候选驱动验证相结合，并在真实机器人上进行了部署。

TLDR: CoRelNav introduces a multi-robot collaborative framework for spatially constrained semantic navigation, coupling task-conditioned exploration with candidate-driven verification and deploying on real robots.

Abstract: Spatially constrained semantic navigation requires robots to identify targets specified not only by semantic categories but also by relations to surrounding objects. In unknown environments, resolving such goals requires efficient exploration together with sufficient target and contextual evidence for reliable relation verification. Existing methods leave relation-aware verification and multi-robot collaboration largely disconnected: relational navigation is predominantly single-agent, while multi-robot systems seldom coordinate distributed observations for instance-specific relation verification. We propose CoRelNav, whose core is coupling task-conditioned multi-robot exploration with candidate-driven collaborative verification. A spatial-semantic field converts task constraints, scene nodes, and object features into exploration utility; as candidate information accumulates, robots are reallocated toward complementary evidence under team navigation costs, while instance-consistent observations are aggregated across topology nodes. This coupling reduces redundant search and enables relation hypotheses to be resolved from distributed partial evidence that independent exploration or isolated-view verification can leave ambiguous. Experiments in photorealistic simulation demonstrate consistent improvements over representative baselines, with ablations validating the proposed exploration and verification mechanisms. We further deploy the complete system on two physical mobile robots, demonstrating its applicability to real-world collaborative navigation.

摘要（中文）：空间约束下的语义导航要求机器人不仅能识别由语义类别指定的目标，还能识别由其与周围物体关系指定的目标。在未知环境中，解决此类目标需要高效探索，同时收集足够的目标及上下文证据，以进行可靠的关系验证。现有方法在很大程度上割裂了关系感知验证与多机器人协作：关系导航主要以单智能体形式实现，而多机器人系统很少协调分布观测以进行面向实例的关系验证。本文提出CoRelNav，其核心在于将任务条件化多机器人探索与候选驱动的协作式验证相结合。空间语义场将任务约束、场景节点和物体特征转化为探索效用；随着候选信息的积累，机器人在团队导航成本约束下被重新分配至互补证据区域，并在拓扑节点间聚合与实例一致的观测信息。这种耦合减少了冗余搜索，并使得关系假设能够基于分布式部分证据得以解决，而独立探索或孤立视角验证往往会使这些证据保持模糊。在逼真仿真中的实验表明，该方法相较于代表性基线具有持续改进，消融实验进一步验证了所提出的探索与验证机制。我们还将完整系统部署在两台实体移动机器人上，展示了其在实际协作导航中的适用性。

Authors: Jinyu He, Zihao Mao, Haonan Jin, Mengyin Fu, Wenjie Song

RegenHarness: A Robot Agent Harness with Evidence-Gated Recursive Self-Improvement Other

robot-agent harness evidence-gated recursive self-improvement long-horizon task execution quadruped deployment

简要说明：RegenHarness 提出了一种基于证据门控的机器人代理框架，用于长时程任务，通过递归自我改进协议根据执行记录更新配置，并在四足机器人上展示了仓库导航与检查应用。

TLDR: RegenHarness introduces an evidence-gated robot-agent harness for long-horizon tasks, with a recursive self-improvement protocol that updates configuration based on execution records, and demonstrates deployment on a quadruped for warehouse navigation and inspection.

Abstract: Long-horizon robot execution requires a clear distinction between a model's proposal, a controller's termination, and verified task completion. We present RegenHarness, an evidence-gated robot-agent harness connecting task planning to heterogeneous robot skills. Its execution architecture couples a model loop for context-conditioned proposals with an agent loop for dispatch, observation, verification, commitment, and bounded recovery. Four role-isolated contexts separate planning, supervision, verification, and recovery inputs. Versioned memory distinguishes observed facts from accepted task progress, while an identity- and version-bound commit gate controls updates to trusted task state. The runtime combines duplicate-dispatch control, resource leases, and recovery budgets under explicit backend contracts, and checks the original user goal before reporting completion. To our knowledge, we are the first to introduce an evidence-gated recursive self-improvement (RSI) protocol for embodied robotic agents. Across missions, execution records motivate candidate changes to context rules, task templates, routing, and recovery policies; fixed regression checks and release authorization govern their acceptance; versioned rollout and rollback preserve configuration traceability. This RSI protocol revises the harness configuration without online model-weight updates or permission to weaken the commit gate. A real quadruped deployment documents voice-triggered warehouse navigation, panoramic inspection, visual analysis, message delivery, return, and spoken reporting through linked audio, images, trajectories, and receipts. A separate circuit demonstrates why completion depends on execution history rather than endpoint proximity alone. Together, the cases demonstrate integrated perception, physical execution, communication, and history-dependent completion in real-world robot tasks.

摘要（中文）：长时程机器人执行要求在模型的提议、控制器的终止以及验证的任务完成之间做出明确区分。我们提出了RegenHarness，一种以证据为门控的机器人智能体框架，将任务规划与异构机器人技能相连接。其执行架构将用于上下文条件化提议的模型循环与用于调度、观察、验证、承诺及有界恢复的智能体循环相结合。四个角色隔离的上下文分别管理规划、监督、验证和恢复输入。带版本管理的记忆区分了观察事实与已接受的任务进展，而身份与版本绑定的提交门控则控制对可信任务状态的更新。该运行时在明确的底层契约下整合了重复调度控制、资源租约和恢复预算，并在报告任务完成之前核对原始用户目标。据我们所知，我们是首个为具身机器人智能体引入证据门控的递归自改进（RSI）协议的研究团队。在各类任务中，执行记录促成了对上下文规则、任务模板、路由和恢复策略的候选修改；固定的回归检查和发布授权管控这些修改的采纳；带版本的推出与回滚保证了配置的可追溯性。该RSI协议在不进行在线模型权重更新、也不允许削弱提交门控的前提下，修订框架配置。一项真实的四足机器人部署记录了通过语音触发的仓库导航、全景巡检、视觉分析、消息传递、返回以及基于链接的音频、图像、轨迹和回执的口头汇报。另一个独立电路示例表明，任务完成依赖于执行历史而非仅依赖终点接近程度。综合来看，这些案例展示了真实世界机器人任务中感知、物理执行、通信以及依赖历史的完成判定的一体化集成。

Authors: Kailin Wang, Haoxiang Jie, Yaoyuan Yan, Zhiyou Heng, Zhaosong Li

Behavior-Aligned Action Tokenization for Robot Policy Learning Manipulation

action tokenization soft dynamic time warping autoregressive policy behavioral correspondence robot policy learning

简要说明：本文提出了一种行为对齐的动作标记化方法（BAAT），利用软动态时间规整对齐不同演示中的动作块，改进共享表示并提升自回归机器人策略学习。

TLDR: This paper proposes a behavior-aligned action tokenization method (BAAT) that uses soft dynamic time warping to align action chunks across demonstrations, improving shared representation and autoregressive robot policy learning.

Abstract: Autoregressive robot policies learn continuous control by predicting discrete action tokens from observations. Different tasks often share local motions, yet behavioral correspondence across demonstrations receives limited explicit supervision in existing tokenizers. Motions with different timing can therefore lack a shared representation despite following similar patterns. We propose Behavior-Aligned Action Tokenization (BAAT), which uses soft dynamic time warping (Soft-DTW) to select corresponding action chunks and aligns their quantized coordinates jointly with reconstruction. This objective encourages similar motions across tasks to occupy nearby quantized representations while retaining executable action detail. A history-conditioned diffusion decoder reconstructs continuous action chunks from these tokens, and a downstream autoregressive policy learns to predict them. We evaluate BAAT on selected tasks from three simulation benchmarks and two real robot tasks. BAAT achieves a mean simulation success rate of approximately 45.2%, exceeding OAT by approximately 7.2 percentage points. In the controlled LIBERO-All alignment ablation, policy success rises from 70.2% to 79.0% while trajectory replay success decreases. These results support behavioral correspondence as supervision for organizing shared motion structure in action tokenizers and improving downstream robot policy learning.

摘要（中文）：自回归机器人策略通过从观测中预测离散动作令牌来学习连续控制。不同任务往往共享局部运动，然而现有令牌化器对跨演示的行为对应关系所施加的显式监督十分有限。因此，即便运动模式相似，时序不同的动作仍可能缺乏共享表示。我们提出行为对齐动作令牌化方法（BAAT），利用软动态时间规整（Soft-DTW）选择对应动作片段，并联合重建过程对其量化坐标进行对齐。该目标促使不同任务中的相似运动在量化表示空间中彼此靠近，同时保留可执行的动作细节。历史条件扩散解码器从这些令牌中重建连续动作片段，下游自回归策略则学习预测这些令牌。我们在三个仿真基准的选定任务及两个真实机器人任务上对BAAT进行了评估。BAAT的平均仿真成功率达到约45.2%，比OAT高出约7.2个百分点。在受控的LIBERO-All对齐消融实验中，策略成功率从70.2%提升至79.0%，而轨迹回放成功率有所下降。这些结果支持将行为对应性作为监督信号，用于组织动作令牌化器中的共享运动结构，并提升下游机器人策略学习效果。

Authors: Junbo Dong, Ze Chen, Zhendong Xie, Junjie Li, Lixin Xu, Xuemin Chi, Yiming Song, Zhaoyuan Ma

Collocated Shape Regulation for Soft Robots Manipulation

collocated shape control continuum soft robots PD/PID controllers stability guarantees experimental validation

简要说明：本文提出了连续体软机器人共置形状控制的通用框架，统一了PD、PID和PsatID控制器，并提供了可证明的稳定性保证和广泛的实验验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a general framework for collocated shape control of continuum soft robots, unifying PD, PID, and PsatID controllers with provable stability guarantees and extensive experimental validation.

Abstract: Controlling the shape of a continuum soft robot typically requires an accurate dynamic model and actuation of all degrees of freedom. We show that regulating only the actuated coordinates, through collocated shape control, achieves provably stable convergence of those coordinates and, under an explicit compatibility condition, of the entire robot shape. While collocated control is a cornerstone of high-performance motion control in rigid robotics, extending this formulation to continuum soft robots has remained challenging due to the complexity of their dynamics. We present the first general framework for collocated control of continuum soft robots and derive a unified family of controllers, including PD, PID, PsatID, and their counterparts with compensation and cancellation components. The framework unifies existing approaches while introducing new controller designs. In particular, we develop three classes of PD and PID like regulators with local, semi-global, and global stability guarantees, and provide rigorous convergence analyses for each. Extensive experimental validation demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed methods across different model discretizations and controller parameters. The resulting framework provides practical design guidelines for selecting and implementing controllers with known stability guarantees, without requiring a complete dynamic model of the robot

摘要（中文）：控制连续体软体机器人的形状通常需要精确的动力学模型以及对所有自由度的驱动。我们证明，仅通过共置形状控制调节被驱动的坐标，即可实现这些坐标的可证明稳定收敛，并且在明确的相容性条件下，还能实现整个机器人形状的稳定收敛。尽管共置控制是刚性机器人高性能运动控制的基石，但由于连续体软体机器人动力学的复杂性，将该方法推广至此类机器人仍面临挑战。我们提出了首个面向连续体软体机器人共置控制的通用框架，并推导出一系列统一的控制器，包括PD、PID、PsatID及其带补偿和抵消项的对应形式。该框架统一了现有方法，同时引入了新的控制器设计。具体而言，我们开发了三类具有局部、半全局和全局稳定性保证的PD类及PID类调节器，并为每一类提供了严格的收敛性分析。大量实验验证表明，所提出的方法在不同模型离散化和控制器参数下均有效。该框架为选择和实现具有已知稳定性保证的控制器提供了实用的设计指导，且无需完整的机器人动力学模型。

Authors: Pietro Pustina, Ebrahim Shahabi, Daniel Feliu-Talegon, Alessandro De Luca, Cosimo Della Santina

Kairos: Grounded Forecasting of Presence and Directional Flow in 4D Scene Graphs Other

4D scene graphs directional flow presence forecasting pedestrian motion prediction robot navigation

简要说明：Kairos提出了一种预测性方向流记忆，将3D场景图扩展为4D，能够在任意未来时间预测行人的存在概率和完整运动方向分布，并在真实机器人采集和长期监控数据上进行了验证。

TLDR: Kairos introduces a predictive directional-flow memory that extends 3D scene graphs to 4D, forecasting both presence probability and full directional motion distributions for pedestrians at arbitrary future times, validated on real robot-collected and long-term surveillance data.

Abstract: Long-term autonomy in human-populated environments requires anticipating whether and how people will move at times a robot has not yet observed. Existing representations of pedestrian motion face a tradeoff: they either forecast future activity, reducing each location to a scalar rate, or model the full directional distribution, holding it fixed in time. We present Kairos, a predictive directional-flow memory that extends a hierarchical 3D scene graph (3DSG) to a 4D scene graph (4DSG). Every observed voxel of the reconstructed geometry stores a directional mixture and a presence rate, and spectral predictors forecast, for any future query time, both the probability that people are present and the full directional distribution of their motion. Pairwise flow dependence between adjacent voxels supports conditional queries, and per-voxel predictive variances yield calibrated credible intervals that tighten as observations accumulate. We evaluate Kairos on three real pedestrian environments: a robot-collected campus dataset, a shopping mall, and a station concourse recorded continuously for eleven months. Its learned state remains consistent under loop-closure corrections, and its forecasts are competitive with dedicated occupancy and flow models trained on the full detection stream, although Kairos learns from only the small fraction available to a patrolling robot. Finally, we validate the representation on a downstream encounter-probability planning task, where plans computed over the Kairos forecasts encounter more people than plans computed over any time-invariant map at an equal success rate. We provide the code at https://github.com/IacopomC/kairos.

摘要（中文）：长期在人类活动环境中实现自主性，要求机器人能够预测在尚未观测到的时刻，人们是否会移动以及如何移动。现有的行人运动表示方法面临一种权衡：要么预测未来活动，将每个位置简化为一个标量速率；要么建模完整的方向分布，但将其在时间上固定不变。我们提出了Kairos，一种预测性方向流记忆，将分层三维场景图（3DSG）扩展为四维场景图（4DSG）。重建几何体的每个被观测体素存储一个方向混合分布和一个存在率，谱预测器针对任何未来查询时间，预测人员存在的概率以及其运动的完整方向分布。相邻体素之间的成对流动依赖性支持条件查询，且每个体素的预测方差可生成校准的置信区间，该区间随观测积累而逐渐收紧。我们在三个真实行人环境中评估了Kairos：一个由机器人采集的校园数据集、一个购物中心，以及一个连续记录十一个月的车站大厅。其学习到的状态在闭环校正下保持一致性，其预测与在完整检测流上训练的专用占用和流动模型相比具有竞争力，尽管Kairos仅从巡逻机器人可获得的一小部分数据中学习。最后，我们在一个下游遭遇概率规划任务中验证了该表示，在成功率相同的情况下，基于Kairos预测计算出的计划所遇到的人数多于基于任何时间不变地图计算出的计划。代码已提供于https://github.com/IacopomC/kairos。

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于工业控制电子设备自动拆卸与维修的模块化双臂机器人单元，基于 ROS 2 控制、行为树、力受限技能和 CAD 派生设备图，在仿真、遥操作和真实硬件上处理各种拆卸任务。

TLDR: This paper presents a modular dual-arm robotic cell for automated disassembly and repair of industrial control electronics, using ROS 2-based control, behavior trees, force-limited skills, and CAD-derived device graphs to handle various disassembly tasks across simulation, teleoperation, and real hardware.

Abstract: Industrial control electronics such as programmable logic controllers, servo drives and operator panels are routinely repaired in plant maintenance, but were never designed for automated disassembly. This paper presents a modular dual-arm robotic cell for repair-oriented disassembly, using two collaborative manipulators, interchangeable tools, red-green-blue-depth (RGB-D) and wristlevel perception, force/torque sensing and a Robot Operating System (ROS) 2- based control with Behavior Tree (BT) execution, teleoperation, digital-twin support and bounded learning-based contact skills. The process is decomposed into sequence planning, symbolic execution with fallbacks, force-limited tool skills, visual condition assessment and demonstration-based adaptation. A CADderived device graph encodes the disassembly order, access constraints, tools, feasible removal directions and verification states and converts them into operation objects for the BT and motion layers. Grounded in three representative devices, the cell covers screw removal, damaged-fastener fallback, snap-fit opening, connector release, cooperative printed circuit board (PCB) extraction and condition-based repair decisions. The main contribution is an architecture linking sequence knowledge, perception, verification and force-aware skills through one ROS 2 interface across simulation, teleoperation and real hardware.

摘要（中文）：工业控制电子设备，如可编程逻辑控制器、伺服驱动器和操作面板，通常在工厂维护中进行常规维修，但这些设备从未被设计为支持自动化拆解。本文提出了一种模块化双臂机器人单元，用于面向维修的拆解任务，该单元采用两个协作机械臂、可互换工具、红绿蓝-深度（RGB-D）感知、腕部级感知、力/力矩传感，以及基于机器人操作系统（ROS）2的控制系统，具备行为树（BT）执行、遥操作、数字孪生支持和基于学习的受限接触技能。该流程被分解为序列规划、带回退的符号执行、力受限工具技能、视觉状态评估和基于演示的适配。基于CAD生成的设备图编码了拆解顺序、访问约束、工具、可行移除方向和验证状态，并将其转换为行为树和运动层可操作的对象。以三类代表性设备为基础，该机器人单元涵盖了螺钉移除、损坏紧固件回退、卡扣开启、连接器释放、协作式印刷电路板（PCB）提取以及基于状态的维修决策。主要贡献在于提出了一种架构，通过统一的ROS 2接口，将序列知识、感知、验证和力感知技能串联起来，并适用于仿真、遥操作和真实硬件环境。

Authors: Maximilian Ruhe, Fabian Harlacher, Christian Friedrich, Martin Kipfmueller

BladeMaster: Real-Time Robotic Cutting Simulation with Online-Generated Persistent Discontinuities Manipulation

robotic cutting simulation material point method persistent discontinuities tool-material coupling GPU-accelerated

简要说明：BladeMaster提出了一种基于全拉格朗日物质点法的GPU加速机器人切割仿真框架，通过持久侧标签处理渐进和交叉切割，无需预定义切割面，实现快速刀具切割与操作。

TLDR: BladeMaster introduces a GPU-accelerated robotic cutting simulation framework based on the total Lagrangian material point method, using persistent side labels to handle progressive and intersecting cuts without predefined cut surfaces, enabling fast tool-driven cutting and manipulation.

Abstract: Cutting changes both the shape and topology of deformable objects, making accurate simulation challenging for robotic manipulation. A simulator must track the cutting tool as a cut develops, preserve the resulting discontinuities after tool withdrawal, and enable newly exposed surfaces to interact with the tool and with each other. Existing formulations often prescribe cut surfaces in advance or couple material separation to auxiliary geometric fields. We introduce BladeMaster, a GPU-accelerated cutting framework based on the total Lagrangian material point method (TLMPM). Our key idea is to encode the cutting history directly on material points through persistent side labels generated online from the blade geometry. These labels govern particle-grid coupling, preserving connectivity within intact material while preventing spurious coupling across cut faces after tool withdrawal. Our formulation supports progressive and intersecting cuts without predefined cut surfaces or particle duplication. Material-material contact enables cut surfaces to recontact and slide against each other without reconnecting, while two-way tool-material coupling allows material reaction forces to influence tool motion. Experiments demonstrate tool-driven cutting followed by manipulation, with faster-than-real-time performance on representative tasks.

摘要（中文）：切割会同时改变可变形物体的形状与拓扑结构，这使得机器人在操作过程中的精确模拟颇具挑战性。模拟器必须追踪切割工具在切口形成过程中的运动轨迹，在工具撤出后保持由此产生的非连续性，并确保新暴露的表面能够与工具及彼此之间进行交互。现有方法往往预先规定切割表面，或将材料分离与辅助几何场耦合在一起。我们提出了BladeMaster，这是一个基于全拉格朗日物质点法（TLMPM）的GPU加速切割框架。我们的核心思想是，通过从刀片几何体在线生成的持久侧面标签，直接将切割历史编码在物质点上。这些标签控制粒子-网格耦合，在保持完好材料内部连通性的同时，防止工具撤出后切割面之间产生虚假的耦合。我们的公式支持渐进切割和交叉切割，无需预先定义切割表面或复制粒子。材料-材料接触使得切割表面能够重新接触并相互滑动而不会重新连接，同时双向工具-材料耦合允许材料反作用力影响工具运动。实验展示了工具驱动的切割及后续操作，在代表性任务上实现了超实时性能。

Authors: Zhanyu Yang, Yunuo Chen, Yanjia Huang, Joseph Masterjohn, Yin Yang, Chenfanfu Jiang

Spatial and Semantic Reasoning for LLM-Driven Robot Navigation via MCP Other

LLM-driven navigation Model Context Protocol ROS occupancy grid spatial reasoning

简要说明：本文提出了一种非侵入性框架，通过模型上下文协议（MCP）将LLM推理与基于ROS的机器人导航连接起来，在模拟室内环境中实现了空间和语义导航任务。

TLDR: This paper presents a non-invasive framework that connects LLM reasoning with ROS-based robot navigation through a navigation-oriented representation layer exposed via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), enabling spatial and semantic navigation tasks in simulated indoor environments.

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as natural-language interfaces for robotic systems, yet their integration with Robot Operating System (ROS)-based navigation remains limited by two gaps. First, navigation data such as occupancy grids are represented as raw geometric messages that are difficult for LLMs to use directly as spatial or semantic context. Second, adding LLM-driven capabilities often requires custom wrappers or robot-specific interfaces, limiting reuse across systems. To address these challenges, we propose a non-invasive framework that connects LLM reasoning with ROS-based navigation through a navigation-oriented representation layer, exposed through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) as standardized, reusable tools so that any MCP-compatible LLM can access them without robot-specific wrappers. The visual map modules transform occupancy grids into metric, pose-aware images for goal reasoning, while the semantic annotation modules record waypoint-level observations with robot poses. We evaluate the framework on three tasks: autonomous mapping, spatial reasoning-based navigation, and semantic reasoning-based navigation. The results show that the evaluated LLM backends use these representations to achieve over 97% map coverage and select spatial or semantic navigation targets from natural-language instructions in a simulated indoor environment. This demonstrates representation-mediated LLM navigation without modifying the existing ROS navigation stack.

摘要（中文）：大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地被用作机器人系统的自然语言接口，然而它们与基于机器人操作系统（ROS）的导航系统的集成仍受到两个差距的限制。首先，诸如占据栅格之类的导航数据以原始几何消息的形式表示，这使得LLMs难以直接将其用作空间或语义上下文。其次，增加LLM驱动的能力通常需要自定义封装器或特定于机器人的接口，从而限制了跨系统的复用。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种非侵入式框架，通过面向导航的表示层将LLM推理与基于ROS的导航连接起来，并通过模型上下文协议（MCP）将其暴露为标准化、可复用的工具，使得任何兼容MCP的LLM都能访问这些工具，而无需特定于机器人的封装器。视觉地图模块将占据栅格转换为度量化的、带有姿态感知的图像，用于目标推理，而语义标注模块则记录带有机器人姿态的航点级观测。我们在三个任务上评估了该框架：自主建图、基于空间推理的导航和基于语义推理的导航。结果表明，所评估的LLM后端利用这些表示在模拟室内环境中实现了超过97%的地图覆盖率，并能从自然语言指令中选择空间或语义导航目标。这证明了在不修改现有ROS导航栈的情况下，通过表示中介实现LLM导航的可行性。

Authors: Jungsoo Lee, Jaegyun Park, Wansoo Kim

DUGM-R: Uncertainty-Aware Dynamic Grid Mapping and Risk-Triggered Recovery for Learned Local Navigation RLRobot

uncertainty-aware dynamic grid map risk value function recovery policy learned local navigation reinforcement learning

简要说明：本文提出DUGM-R，一种用于拥挤室内环境下局部导航的风险感知强化学习框架，结合了不确定性感知的动态栅格地图和由风险价值函数触发的后训练恢复策略，并在仿真和TurtleBot3真实机器人上进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper presents DUGM-R, a risk-aware RL framework for local navigation in crowded indoor environments, combining an uncertainty-aware dynamic grid map with a post-training recovery policy triggered by a risk value function, and validates it in simulation and on a TurtleBot3 real robot.

Abstract: Learned local navigation in crowded indoor environments is sensitive to how dynamic obstacle motion is represented, while collision-prone behaviour may persist after nominal policy training. We present a risk-aware reinforcement-learning framework that addresses these two issues through an uncertainty-aware Dynamic Uncertainty Grid Map (DUGM) and a modular post-training recovery mechanism. DUGM combines local occupancy, estimated obstacle motion, and motion-estimation uncertainty in a robot-centric representation. After the nominal policy is frozen, a finite-horizon Risk Value Function (RVF) is trained from nominal rollouts and used to trigger a dedicated recovery policy when continued nominal execution is predicted to be collision-prone. Experiments in a held-out NVIDIA Isaac Sim clinical-logistics benchmark show that uncertainty-aware dynamic representation improves nominal navigation over static and deterministic alternatives, while the recovery mechanism further mitigates residual collision-prone behaviour. The complete framework is also deployed directly on a TurtleBot3 without policy fine-tuning, retraining, or site-specific adaptation, retaining the performance trend observed in simulation. These results indicate that uncertainty-aware dynamic representation and post-training recovery provide complementary mechanisms for improving learned local navigation.

摘要（中文）：在拥挤的室内环境中，学习型局部导航对动态障碍物运动的表示方式高度敏感，而在名义策略训练完成后，碰撞倾向行为仍可能持续存在。我们提出了一种风险感知的强化学习框架，通过不确定性感知的动态不确定性栅格图（DUGM）和模块化的训练后恢复机制来解决这两个问题。DUGM在机器人中心表示中融合了局部占用信息、估计的障碍物运动以及运动估计的不确定性。在名义策略被冻结后，从名义轨迹中训练一个有限时域的风险值函数（RVF），当预测持续执行名义策略将导致碰撞倾向时，该函数用于触发专门的恢复策略。在独立的NVIDIA Isaac Sim临床物流基准测试中进行的实验表明，与静态和确定性替代方案相比，不确定性感知的动态表示提升了名义导航性能，同时恢复机制进一步缓解了残留的碰撞倾向行为。完整的框架还直接部署在TurtleBot3上，无需策略微调、重新训练或场景特定适配，保持了仿真中观察到的性能趋势。这些结果表明，不确定性感知的动态表示与训练后恢复机制为改进学习型局部导航提供了互补的手段。

Authors: Haoyun Feng, Adrian Rubio-Solis, Zhaodong Guo, George Mylonas

Memory That Changes Action Is Not Memory That Guides It: Counterfactual Auditing of History-Conditioned Robot Policies Manipulation

counterfactual audit memory-conditioned policies robot manipulation history-conditioned policies evaluation protocol

简要说明：本文提出了一种反事实记忆审计（CMA）协议，用于评估历史条件机器人策略是否真正利用记忆来指导决策，证明记忆敏感的行为可能并非由记忆引导。

TLDR: This paper proposes a Counterfactual Memory Audit (CMA) protocol to evaluate whether history-conditioned robot policies truly use memory to guide decisions, demonstrating that memory-sensitive actions may not be memory-guided.

Abstract: A robot returning a block to its origin tray may encounter two task-consistent pasts that reconverge to the same current input but warrant different actions. Yet memory-policy evaluations often rely on task success or action change under memory perturbation, neither of which establishes that memory guides the decision. We propose the \textbf{Counterfactual Memory Audit (CMA)}, an evaluation protocol that crosses two histories at a verified-identical present, queries a frozen policy under common randomness, and evaluates each saved action under both pasts. This separates memory sensitivity, warranted choice, matched-world physical value, and per-pair reliability. On Mem-0, every audited Put Back pair changes action, but only $20/64$ pairs are fully reliable; at a later Swap decision, all paired actions change while both memories select the same branch. Native interventions further show closed-loop influence: replacing the history bank redirects behavior toward the replaced content, while restoring a 4096-byte protected anchor recovers $38.9$ points of Swap success lost to injected bank faults. On a dual-arm physical platform, memory changes saved actions, yet five of nine completed Put Back manipulations reach the wrong target. These results show that a robot can remember and react without reliably using memory to choose the behavior its past warrants. CMA provides a decision-level audit for distinguishing these cases.

摘要（中文）：将方块放回原位托盘的机器人可能会遇到两种与任务一致的历史情境，它们汇聚到相同的当前输入，却要求不同的动作。然而，记忆策略的评估往往依赖于任务成功与否，或记忆扰动下动作是否改变，而这两者都无法证明记忆指导了决策。我们提出**反事实记忆审计（CMA）**，一种评估协议，它在经过验证的相同当下交叉两个历史情境，在共同随机性下查询冻结策略，并在两种过去情境下评估每个保存的动作。这将记忆敏感性、应然选择、匹配世界的物理价值以及逐对可靠性分离开来。在Mem-0上，每个被审计的“放回”配对都会改变动作，但只有$20/64$个配对完全可靠；在后续的“交换”决策中，所有配对动作都会改变，而两种记忆却选择了相同的分支。原生干预进一步显示了闭环影响：替换历史库会使行为转向被替换的内容，而恢复一个4096字节的保护锚点则挽回了因注入库故障而损失的$38.9$点“交换”成功率。在双臂物理平台上，记忆改变了保存的动作，但九次完成的“放回”操作中有五次到达了错误目标。这些结果表明，机器人可以记忆并作出反应，却并未可靠地利用记忆来选择其过去所应然的行为。CMA提供了一种决策层面的审计，用以区分这些情况。

Authors: Jiajie Zhang, Yankai Xiang, Changhao Chen

A Quasi-Direct-Drive Underactuated Asymmetric Hand for Dexterous and Efficient Grasping and Manipulation Manipulation

quasi-direct-drive underactuated hand dexterous grasping biomimetic asymmetry compliant coupling

简要说明：本文介绍了 Berkeley QUAD 手，一种四指欠驱动机械手，采用准直驱驱动和仿生不对称设计，兼顾灵巧性与力量，实现了 Feix 分类中 33 个抓取中的 29 个，并大幅减少了热量产生。

TLDR: This paper presents the Berkeley QUAD Hand, a four-finger underactuated robotic hand with quasi-direct-drive actuation and a bio-inspired asymmetric design that balances dexterity and strength, achieving 29 of 33 Feix taxonomy grasps and greatly reduced heat generation.

Abstract: In this paper, we present the Berkeley QUAD (Quasi-direct-drive, Underactuated, Asymmetric Design) Hand, a four-finger anthropomorphic robotic hand with 11 degrees of freedom and 8 degrees of actuation. The design utilizes QDD actuation at the base of each finger, enabling high force transparency for dexterous, adaptive performance. However, the low torque density of these actuators traditionally presents major issues with size, weight, and thermal limits. We overcome this by applying bio-inspired asymmetry, delegating dexterity to the radial fingers through individual QDD actuation, and strength to the ulnar finger through an underactuated, compliantly coupled transmission driven by a larger QDD motor. A novel preloaded, linkage-based transmission permits this ulnar coupling in a way that preserves human-like workspace reachability. Under light loads, the ulnar motor drives the third (middle) finger directly for dexterity while the fourth (ring) finger mirrors its motion. However, under larger loads, the middle finger complies while the motor drives the ring finger further downwards and inwards toward the center of the grasp to apply better closure forces. Hardware evaluations validate this architecture, demonstrating that the hand achieves 29 out of 33 Feix taxonomy grasps and exhibits backdrive forces as low as 50 g for delicate interactions. Additionally, the underactuated fourth finger improves grasp closure and provides the spatial efficiency necessary for larger actuation, yielding up to a 96-fold reduction in heat generation during sustained loading. Webpage: https://benudavis.github.io/berkeley-quadhand/

摘要（中文）：本文介绍了伯克利QUAD（准直驱、欠驱动、非对称设计）手——一种具有11个自由度和8个驱动自由度的四指仿人机械手。该设计在每根手指的根部采用准直驱（QDD）驱动，实现高力透明性，以支持灵巧、自适应的操作性能。然而，这类执行器固有的低扭矩密度通常在尺寸、重量和热限制方面带来重大问题。我们通过引入仿生非对称设计克服了这些挑战：将灵巧性分配给桡侧手指（通过独立的QDD驱动实现），而将力量分配给尺侧手指（通过由更大QDD电机驱动的欠驱动、柔性耦合传动实现）。一种新颖的基于预紧连杆的传动机构使尺侧耦合在保持类人工作空间可达性的前提下得以实现。在轻载荷条件下，尺侧电机直接驱动第三指（中指）以完成灵巧操作，同时第四指（无名指）镜像其运动。但在较大载荷下，中指发生顺应变形，而电机则驱动无名指进一步向下并向抓取中心内侧运动，以施加更好的收拢力。硬件评估验证了该架构的有效性，结果表明该手能够完成Feix分类中33种抓取姿态中的29种，并表现出低至50克的背驱力，适用于精细交互场景。此外，欠驱动的第四指改善了抓取闭合效果，并为更大驱动提供了必要的空间效率，在持续加载条件下热生成量降低了多达96倍。网页：https://benudavis.github.io/berkeley-quadhand/

Authors: Benjamin Davis, Chase Kidder, Hannah S. Stuart

Median Temporal Ensembling: Training-Free Robust Aggregation for Action-Chunked Visuomotor Policies Manipulation

temporal ensembling median aggregation action-chunked visuomotor policies adversarial corruption robustness

简要说明：本文提出一种免训练的坐标中位数时间集成方法，用于动作分块视觉运动策略，以提高对预测对抗性破坏的鲁棒性，在干净数据上无显著代价，并在攻击下改善恢复。

TLDR: This paper proposes a training-free coordinate-wise median temporal ensembling method for action-chunked visuomotor policies to improve robustness against adversarial corruption of predictions, with no significant cost on clean data and improved recovery under attacks.

Abstract: Action-chunked visuomotor policies predict overlapping trajectories, so every executed action is covered by several predictions. Temporal ensembling smooths execution by combining these predictions with an exponentially weighted mean. One corrupted prediction can move the aggregate without bound: its breakdown point is 0. We use adversarial corruption to stress this deployed aggregator and to compare two kinds of guarantee. A metric guarantee bounds the response to a perturbation of a given size. A combinatorial guarantee instead bounds the damage when at most q of the M candidates covering a timestep are corrupted, whatever their size. Encoder adversarial fine-tuning recovers 44% of the loss under the published patch attack, but only 7.3% after the attacker's step size is increased. By contrast, the coordinate-wise median of the same candidate set keeps its recovered fraction flat as attack optimisation increases. Median temporal ensembling costs one line and requires no retraining. Across 25 (configuration, corruption-level) combinations it is never worse than the mean and is significantly better in 15. It also transfers to a second policy class, and it recovers performance under a failure with no attacker in the loop at all: camera frames that arrive blank. Its effect on clean data is configuration-dependent, from -0.04 to +0.07. We also give the boundary: corruption that shifts every covering prediction by the same amount is invisible to this whole family of statistics, and no equivariant aggregator can remove it.

摘要（中文）：行为分块的视觉运动策略会预测重叠轨迹，因此每一个执行的动作都会被多个预测覆盖。时间集成通过指数加权平均结合这些预测来平滑执行过程。然而，一个被破坏的预测就可能使聚合结果无界偏移：其崩溃点为零。我们利用对抗性破坏来施压这一已部署的聚合器，并比较两类保证。度量保证限定了对给定大小扰动的响应范围；而组合保证则限定了当覆盖某一时间步的M个候选预测中至多有q个被破坏时（无论其破坏程度如何）所造成的损害。在已发表的补丁攻击下，编码器对抗微调恢复了44%的损失，但当攻击者的步长增大后，恢复率仅为7.3%。相比之下，同一候选集的逐坐标中位数在攻击优化增强时保持恢复比例平稳。中位数时间集成仅需一行代码且无需重新训练。在25种（配置、破坏水平）组合中，它从不劣于均值方法，并在15种组合中显著更优。该方法还可迁移至第二类策略，并且在无攻击者介入的故障场景（如摄像头帧空白）下也能恢复性能。其对干净数据的影响取决于配置，范围从-0.04到+0.07。我们还给出了边界情况：如果破坏使所有覆盖预测发生相同偏移，则对整个统计家族均不可见，且任何等变聚合器都无法消除这种偏移。

Authors: Yuhang Jiang

Design and Modeling of a Single-Port Three-Arm Robotic Tool for Minimally Invasive Neurosurgery Manipulation

surgical robot tendon-driven kinematic modeling minimally invasive single-port

简要说明：本文提出一种用于微创神经外科的单孔三臂机器人的设计与建模，包含12自由度肌腱驱动可转向套管，并与7自由度机械臂集成，通过实验验证了其静力学和运动学模型。

TLDR: This paper presents the design and kinematic modeling of a single-port, three-arm robotic tool with 12 DoFs for minimally invasive neurosurgery, integrating tendon-driven steerable cannulas with a 7-DoF robotic arm, and validates its static and kinematic models experimentally.

Abstract: Surgical robots require highly dexterous and compact robotic systems capable of operating effectively within confined anatomical spaces. However, due to limited access provided by a single incision, the miniaturization and maneuverability of these robots still need to be improved. In this paper, we propose the design and modeling of a single-port three-arm robotic tool containing one major cannula (7.14 mm outer diameter (OD)) and three steerable minor cannulas (1.93 mm OD). By integrating the proposed 12 degrees-of-freedom (DoFs) steerable robotic tool with a 7-DoF robotic arm, this robotic system can potentially achieve multi-arm manipulation capability. We present the design of the steerable robotic tool consisting of tendon-driven joints controlled by a compact actuation system, derive the kinematic model, and validate both the static and kinematic models through experiments. The performance is evaluated with the root mean square error (RMSE) and mean absolute error (MAE) computed between the experimental data and the kinematic model.

摘要（中文）：手术机器人需要高度灵巧且紧凑的机器人系统，以便在受限的解剖空间内有效操作。然而，由于单一切口提供的操作通道有限，这些机器人的小型化和可操作性仍需改进。本文提出了一种单端口三臂机器人工具的设计与建模，该工具包含一个主管套（外径7.14毫米）和三个可转向的副管套（外径1.93毫米）。通过将所提出的12自由度可转向机器人工具与一个7自由度机械臂集成，该机器人系统有望实现多臂操作能力。我们介绍了由腱驱动关节组成的可转向机器人工具的设计，该工具由紧凑的驱动系统控制，推导了运动学模型，并通过实验验证了静力学模型和运动学模型的准确性。性能评估通过计算实验数据与运动学模型之间的均方根误差（RMSE）和平均绝对误差（MAE）来完成。

Authors: Nazia H. Dana, Harith S. Gallage, Ismail A. Auta, Dhanvi Yuvaraj, Ronghuai Qi

Intelligence Across Embodiments Other

cross-embodiment learning embodiment diversity learned priors transfer embodied intelligence

简要说明：本文提出跨具身学习是扩展具身智能的关键，主张通过具身多样性和广泛学习先验实现跨机器人形态的迁移，并呼吁设计能表征具身差距的基准。

TLDR: This position paper argues for cross-embodiment learning as a key axis for scaling embodied intelligence, proposing embodiment diversity and broad learned priors to enable transfer across different robot morphologies, and calling for benchmarks that characterize embodiment gaps.

Abstract: Robotic embodiment encompasses the sensing, kinematics, dynamics, geometry, actuation, and control through which an agent physically interacts with the world. These properties vary across robots and change over time. We argue that general embodied intelligence requires learning that accumulates across these differences. Prevailing methods that engineer correspondences to bridge embodiment differences offer immediate practical gains, but their assumptions limit the scope of transfer in the long run. Instead, a more general approach should discover representations that support transfer to a larger range of embodiments as experience grows. We propose embodiment diversity as a promising axis of scaling, and identify broad learned priors as a complementary ingredient. We call for evaluations that better characterize embodiment gaps and transfer performance. More broadly, cross-embodiment learning connects the practical challenge of learning from heterogeneous robot experience with a broader scientific pursuit inspired by nature - physical intelligence that adapts and co-evolves with its embodiments to gain agency over its behavior and physical forms.

摘要（中文）：具身智能（Robotic embodiment）涵盖智能体与物理世界交互所依赖的感知、运动学、动力学、几何结构、驱动与控制等要素。这些属性因机器人不同而各异，并随时间动态变化。我们认为，通用具身智能要求学习过程能够跨越这些差异进行累积。当前主流方法通过人工设计对应关系来桥接具身差异，虽能带来立竿见影的实践收益，但其假设条件从长远来看限制了迁移的范围。相反，更通用的路径应当自主发现表征，使学习经验能够随着积累而迁移至更广泛的具身形态。我们提出将具身多样性作为规模化扩展的重要维度，并指出广泛学习的先验知识是与之互补的关键要素。我们呼吁建立更完善的评估体系，以准确刻画具身差距与迁移性能。更广泛而言，跨具身学习将异构机器人经验学习的实践挑战与受自然启发的更宏大的科学追求——即与其具身形态共同适应、协同进化的物理智能，从而获得对自身行为与物理形态的自主控制力——紧密联结在一起。

Authors: Bo Ai, Henrik I. Christensen, Hao Su

Water Surface Swimming in a Centipede and its Robophysical ModeL Locomotion

multi-legged robots surface swimming body wave leg compliance robophysical model

简要说明：本文研究了蜈蚣和多足机器人的水面游泳行为，发现直接体波游泳模式，并证明方向性腿柔顺性可显著提高游泳性能，为两栖多足机器人建立设计原则。

TLDR: This paper studies surface swimming in centipedes and multi-legged robots, discovering direct body wave swimming and demonstrating that directional leg compliance significantly improves swimming performance, establishing design principles for amphibious multi-legged robots.

Abstract: Elongate multi-legged robots use coordinated body waves and distributed legs to move through cluttered terrestrial environments. However, as housing actuators for independent leg control can require bulky body segments, their non-streamlined body and limb structure makes it difficult to achieve swimming capability comparable to their terrestrial locomotor performance. At the water surface, we found that the multi-legged robots we tested unexpectedly moved backward: their body waves traveled in the same direction as their displacement, i.e., swimming with a direct wave. We found similar behavior in the centipede \textit{Lithobius forficatus}, which swims with a direct body wave and periodic leg movement. To study how distributed legs contribute to direct-wave swimming, we analyze animal kinematics and develop a multi-legged robophysical model that allows independent variation of leg morphology and stiffness, body-wave direction, and leg coordination. Robophysical experiments show that direct body waves produce consistent forward motion under the tested conditions and that swimming performance depends on body--leg coordination. Additionally, directionally compliant legs increase displacement from approximately 0.08 to 0.21 body lengths per cycle relative to rigid legs under matched anti-phase actuation. These findings clarify how distributed appendages contribute to surface swimming and establish gait and morphology design principles for extending multi-legged field robots from terrestrial locomotion into aquatic environments.

摘要（中文）：细长多足机器人通过协调的身体波动和分布式腿部运动，在杂乱的陆地环境中移动。然而，由于为独立腿部控制提供动力的驱动器往往需要笨重的躯干节段，其非流线型身体和肢体结构使其难以实现与陆地运动性能相当的水中游动能力。在水面上，我们发现所测试的多足机器人意外地出现向后移动：其身体波动方向与位移方向相同，即采用直接波方式游动。我们在蜈蚣\textit{Lithobius forficatus}中也发现了类似行为，其以直接身体波和周期性腿部运动进行游动。为研究分布式腿部如何促进直接波游动，我们分析了动物运动学，并开发了一个多足机器人物理模型，该模型允许独立调节腿部形态和刚度、身体波动方向及腿部协调方式。机器人物理实验表明，在测试条件下，直接身体波能产生一致的前向运动，且游动性能取决于身体与腿部的协调性。此外，在匹配的反相驱动下，与刚性腿相比，方向顺应性腿将位移从每周期约0.08体长提高至0.21体长。这些发现阐明了分布式附肢对水面游动的贡献，并为将多足野外机器人从陆地运动拓展至水生环境提供了步态和形态设计原则。

Authors: Zhaochen J. Xu, Delfin Aydin, Abdullah Mustafa, Margarita B. Levin, Jianfeng Lin, Tianyu Wang, Daniel I. Goldman

HiRE: Hindsight Reward Editing for Policy Finetuning Manipulation

reward editing policy finetuning foundation representation reinforcement learning trap states

简要说明：HiRE 是一个无需训练框架，通过对比成功和失败轨迹来校准基础表征模型的奖励，惩罚陷阱状态并提升关键成功状态的奖励，从而提供密集、控制感知的反馈，改善策略微调。

TLDR: HiRE is a training-free framework that improves policy finetuning by contrasting successful and failed trajectories to calibrate foundation representation rewards, penalizing trap states and boosting critical successful states for dense, control-aware feedback.

Abstract: Pre-trained robot policies always require finetuning to adapt to specific environments. Reinforcement Learning (RL) offers high performance potential because it improves action optimality rather than simply mimicking data. However, such potential depends heavily on reward quality. Sparse rewards lack process feedback, human-designed rewards are costly and biased, and semantic rewards from foundation representations are often not control-centric. We propose Hindsight Reward Editing (HiRE), a training-free framework to break this reward bottleneck. HiRE bridges the broad knowledge of foundation representation models with physical control awareness, by contrasting successful and failed trajectories in hindsight. It calibrates foundation representation models by identifying "trap states" that are predicted as high-rewarding states yet eventually result in failure, and vice versa. HiRE explicitly penalizes these traps while boosting rewards for critical successful states. This approach can be flexibly compatible with any foundation representations and RL algorithms. Experiments show that HiRE consistently outperforms other reward recipes by delivering dense, control-aware feedback that prevents value function collapse and reward hacking, thereby achieving superior sample efficiency, stable policy updates, and higher performance ceilings, e.g., at least 3x performance of the base policies. Qualitative results are at https://hire-project.github.io .

摘要（中文）：预训练机器人策略通常需要微调以适应特定环境。强化学习因侧重于提升动作最优性而非简单模仿数据，展现出高性能潜力。然而，这种潜力在很大程度上依赖于奖励质量。稀疏奖励缺乏过程反馈，人工设计的奖励成本高且存在偏差，而基于基础表征的语义奖励往往缺乏控制导向性。我们提出事后奖励编辑（HiRE）——一种免训练框架，旨在打破这一奖励瓶颈。HiRE通过事后对比成功与失败轨迹，将基础表征模型的广泛知识与物理控制感知相衔接。它通过识别“陷阱状态”来校准基础表征模型，这些状态被预测为高奖励状态却最终导致失败，反之亦然。HiRE在提升关键成功状态奖励的同时，显式惩罚这些陷阱。该方法可灵活兼容任意基础表征和强化学习算法。实验表明，HiRE通过提供密集且具有控制意识的反馈，防止价值函数崩溃和奖励欺骗，持续优于其他奖励方案，从而实现更高的样本效率、稳定的策略更新和更高的性能上限，例如，至少达到基础策略性能的3倍。定性结果参见https://hire-project.github.io。

Authors: Haoyi Niu, Zhengtao Han, Yufeng Ji, Zhongyu Li, Koushil Sreenath

MultiPush: Learning to Rearrange with Teams of Car-Like Pushers Manipulation

multi-robot rearrangement car-like robots reinforcement learning Dubins curves constraint-aware traversability graph

简要说明：MultiPush 是一个基于强化学习的多机器人（类车）物体重排框架，利用约束感知的可穿越图与 Dubins 曲线有序分配，联合调度和分配推挤任务，在仿真和真实 1/10 比例车辆上缩短了完工时间并提高了规划效率。

TLDR: MultiPush is a reinforcement-learning framework for multi-robot (car-like) object rearrangement that uses a constraint-aware traversability graph and ordered Dubins curve assignments to jointly schedule and allocate pushing tasks, reducing makespan and planning time in simulation and on real 1/10-scale cars.

Abstract: We focus on the problem of rearranging multiple objects within a constrained workspace via pushing using a team of car-like robots. While the use of multiple robots offers the potential for more efficient execution, the need for conflict resolution and the kinematic constraints arising from physics, robot design, and the workspace boundary make this problem especially challenging. Our key insight is that by exploiting the structure introduced by the car-like kinematics of the domain, we could relax the problem into an ordered assignment of Dubins curves to robots. To this end, we introduce MultiPush, a reinforcement-learning based framework that jointly determines an efficient schedule of pushing tasks and their allocation to available robots by leveraging a constraint-aware traversability graph. Across extensive simulated trials with up to 14 objects and teams of two to four robots, MultiPush reduces the makespan by up to 16% compared to the baselines while requiring up to 2.9 times faster planning time. We demonstrate MultiPush on a real-world scenario involving the rearrangement of 12 objects by two and three robots (1/10-scale racecars) in a constrained space.

摘要（中文）：我们聚焦于在受限工作空间内，利用一组类车机器人通过推挤方式重新排列多个物体的问题。尽管多机器人协同作业有望实现更高的执行效率，但冲突消解的需求以及源自物理特性、机器人设计和 workspace 边界的运动学约束，使得这一问题尤为棘手。我们的核心洞察在于，通过利用领域内类车运动学引入的结构特性，可以将该问题松弛为将Dubins曲线按顺序分配给各机器人的任务。为此，我们提出了MultiPush框架，这是一种基于强化学习的方法，通过利用考虑约束的可穿越图，联合确定高效的推动任务调度及其在可用机器人之间的分配。在多达14个物体以及两至四台机器人团队的广泛模拟试验中，MultiPush相比基线方法将完工时间缩短了最多16%，同时规划时间最多加快了2.9倍。我们还在一个真实场景中演示了MultiPush，该场景涉及两台和三台机器人（1/10比例赛车）在受限空间内重新排列12个物体。
