Authors: Jeeho Ahn, Christoforos Mavrogiannis

Humanoid Locomotion with a Fly-Inspired Recurrent Controller Locomotion

humanoid locomotion recurrent controller embodied control Unitree G1 locomotion robustness

简要说明：本文研究了一种受果蝇启发的循环神经网络控制器用于仿真人形机器人运动，通过多种条件测试和状态替换实验，发现该控制器主要依赖直接身体与指令输入及携带的运动状态，而非深度或上游状态信息。

TLDR: This paper studies a fly-inspired recurrent neural controller for humanoid locomotion in simulation, analyzing how recurrent state and sensory inputs contribute to the policy's success across diverse conditions, and shows that the controller relies on direct body-and-command input and carried motor state rather than depth or upstream-state substitutions.

Abstract: We investigate humanoid locomotion with a fly-inspired recurrent controller and identify the pathways supporting its deployed behavior. The controller couples 3,609 continuous neural states to a simulated Unitree G1 through body-observation projections, a motor-neuron-labelled readout, and joint servos. We formulate this neural-body feedback system and evaluate a fixed checkpoint across seven terrain instances, three speeds, and three initial yaw offsets. It completes 61/63 conditions under a survival-and-forward-progress criterion; a privileged reference completes 62/63. At nominal yaw, resetting the recurrent motor state before every policy call changes success from 19/21 to 0/21. Conversely, depth and upstream-state substitutions at 252 recorded states leave actions unchanged, with zero measured descending output throughout the intact rollouts. Recorded trajectories and state-matched images connect these findings to sustained movement, lateral drift, and termination events. The study characterizes an embodied recurrent control system whose tested locomotion is supported by direct body-and-command input and carried motor state, providing a concrete basis for subsequent comparisons of circuit structure and control resources.

摘要（中文）：我们研究了一种受果蝇启发的循环控制器在仿人机器人 locomotion（运动控制）中的应用，并识别了支撑其实际部署行为的关键通路。该控制器通过身体观测投影、标记为运动神经元的读出层以及关节伺服机制，将3,609个连续的神经状态耦合至仿真环境中的Unitree G1机器人。我们构建了这一神经-身体反馈系统的数学模型，并在七种地形场景、三种运动速度以及三种初始偏航偏移条件下，对固定检查点进行了评估。在“存活并前进”的评判标准下，该系统完成了61/63个测试条件；而一种具备特权信息的参照系统则完成了62/63个条件。在名义偏航条件下，若每次策略调用前重置循环运动状态，成功率由19/21降至0/21。相反，在记录的252个状态下，用深度信息及上游状态进行替代，动作输出保持不变，且在完整 rollout（轨迹展开）过程中测量到的下行输出（descending output）始终为零。记录的运动轨迹与状态匹配图像将这些结果与持续运动、横向漂移及终止事件联系起来。本研究刻画了一个具身循环控制系统，其测试中的运动行为直接依赖于身体与指令输入以及携带的运动状态，为后续电路结构与控制资源的比较提供了具体基础。

Authors: Isabel Guan, Yuntian Zhao, Dingyuan Zhang, Shipeng Lyu

Spiderbot: An Open-Source Energy-Efficient Hexapod with Passive Gravity Compensation Locomotion

hexapod passive gravity compensation energy-efficient sim-to-real reinforcement learning

简要说明：本文介绍了Spiderbot，一种开源六足机器人，通过四连杆和弹簧实现被动重力补偿，站立姿态能耗降低超过90%，并验证了基于强化学习的运动控制及仿真到现实的迁移。

TLDR: This paper presents Spiderbot, an open-source hexapod robot with passive gravity compensation via a 4-bar linkage and spring, achieving over 90% energy reduction in standing stance and validated with RL-based locomotion including sim-to-real transfer.

Abstract: Hexapod robots can achieve static stability with fewer actuated joints than bipeds or quadrupeds, yet many platforms still use 3-DOF legs, increasing weight and continuous torque requirement with limited gain in locomotion capability on flat, inclined and moderately rough terrains. We release Spiderbot, an open-source hexapod that uses a 4-bar linkage with a passive spring to mechanically support body weight, with a 2-DOF per-leg design that substantially reduces energy consumption. This mechanism substantially offloads gravitational torque during standing stance consuming only 1.5W (reduction of over 90\% over the unsprung version and up to 96\% over other similar hexapods). The passive spring compensation extends to payloads of up to 3.25kg with no additional torque requirements. The platform enables long-duration deployments on a modest battery budget and costs under \$400, making it suitable for large-scale multi-agent experiments. We validate the locomotion capabilities of the platform with an RL policy trained in mjlab, including successful sim-to-real transfer, despite the complexity of the mechanism. The platform is evaluated on flat and rough terrains, slope up to $15^\circ$ and step obstacles. We release all the CAD files, assembling instructions, and full training and deployment code along with the model checkpoints at https://erc-bpgc.github.io/SpiderBot/.

摘要（中文）：六足机器人在实现静态稳定性方面，相较于双足或四足机器人所需的驱动关节更少，然而许多平台仍采用三自由度腿部设计，这不仅增加了重量和持续扭矩需求，而且在平坦、倾斜及适度崎岖地形上的运动能力提升却有限。我们发布了Spiderbot，一款开源六足机器人，其采用带有被动弹簧的四杆机构来机械支撑身体重量，每条腿仅需两个自由度，显著降低了能耗。该机构在站立姿态下大幅减轻了重力扭矩，功耗仅为1.5瓦（较无弹簧版本降低超过90%，较其他同类六足机器人最高降低96%）。该被动弹簧补偿机制可支持高达3.25千克的有效载荷，且无需额外扭矩。该平台能够在有限的电池预算下实现长时间部署，成本低于400美元，非常适合大规模多智能体实验。我们通过在mjlab中训练的强化学习策略验证了该平台的运动能力，尽管机构复杂，仍成功实现了仿真到现实的迁移。该平台在平坦地形、崎岖地形、最大15度坡道及台阶障碍上均进行了评估。我们已开源所有CAD文件、装配说明、完整训练与部署代码及模型检查点，详见https://erc-bpgc.github.io/SpiderBot/。

Authors: Ritwik Sharma, Vimarsh Shah, Saransh Agrawal

Teach-to-Crash: A Closed-Loop Student-Teacher LLM Framework for Collision-Inducing Test Scenario Generation AutonomousDriving

closed-loop testing LLM scenario generation CARLA adversarial search

简要说明：Teach-to-Crash 是一个用于自动驾驶仿真中对抗性场景生成的闭环双大语言模型框架。它利用高推理能力的教师大语言模型指导低推理能力的学生大语言模型生成可执行的测试场景，在CARLA中相比现有方法显著提高了发现多样、可避免碰撞的能力。

TLDR: Teach-to-Crash is a closed-loop, dual-LLM framework for adversarial scenario generation in autonomous driving simulation. It uses a high-reasoning Teacher LLM to guide a low-reasoning Student LLM in producing executable test scenarios, dramatically improving the discovery of diverse, avoidable collisions in CARLA compared to existing methods.

Abstract: Validating Autonomous Driving Systems (ADS) in simulation requires testing architectures that can discover rare, safety-critical failures while generating scenarios that are executable, diverse, and useful for downstream failure analysis. We introduce Teach-to-Crash, a closed-loop testing framework that combines a constrained ego-centric scenario representation, stagnation-aware search control, and a dual-LLM architecture for adaptive failure discovery. A high-reasoning Teacher LLM acts as an adaptive search controller, while a low-reasoning Student LLM emits simulator-executable scenarios in a strict JSON schema. The Teacher intervenes only when rolling collision rate and time-to-collision metrics stagnate, providing strategic guidance to redirect the search. In a CARLA case study with two experimental setups that vary the ego vehicle's speed policy, Teach-to-Crash achieves the highest Collision Hit Rate (90.79%), the shortest mean Time-to-Collision (18.31 s), and a competitive Collision Discovery Rate (136.21). PAFOT attains a higher mean CDR (179.44), but with substantially larger variance. Teach-to-Crash also yields the highest diversity (0.547) and, averaged across both setups on the CARLA Traffic Manager controller, the highest avoidability-based usefulness proxy (60.04%) among the compared methods. These results, within the evaluated CARLA scope, provide evidence that closed-loop dual-LLM reasoning can steer adversarial simulation-based testing over a constrained executable program space, generating failures that are frequent, structurally diverse, and assessed as more frequently avoidable.

摘要（中文）：验证自动驾驶系统（ADS）在仿真环境中的性能，需要测试架构能够发现罕见的安全关键性失效，同时生成可执行、多样化且有助于下游失效分析的场景。我们提出 **Teach-to-Crash**，一种闭环测试框架，结合了受限的以自我为中心的场景表示、停滞感知搜索控制，以及双大语言模型（dual-LLM）架构，以实现自适应失效发现。高推理能力的教师大语言模型（Teacher LLM）充当自适应搜索控制器，而低推理能力的学生大语言模型（Student LLM）则按照严格的 JSON 模式生成可在仿真器中执行的场景。教师仅在滚动碰撞率和碰撞时间指标停滞时介入，提供策略性指导以重定向搜索。在 CARLA 的案例研究中，通过两种改变自我车辆速度策略的实验设置，Teach-to-Crash 实现了最高的碰撞命中率（90.79%）、最短的平均碰撞时间（18.31 秒），以及具有竞争力的碰撞发现率（136.21）。PAFOT 获得了更高的平均碰撞发现率（179.44），但方差显著更大。Teach-to-Crash 还取得了最高的多样性得分（0.547），并且在两种设置下基于 CARLA 交通管理控制器的平均结果中，其基于可避免性的有用性代理指标（60.04%）优于所有对比方法。在评估的 CARLA 范围内，这些结果表明，闭环双大语言模型推理能够在受限的可执行程序空间上引导对抗性仿真测试，生成频繁、结构多样化且更常被视为可避免的失效场景。

Authors: Zaid Ghazal, Khouloud Gaaloul, Bruce Maxim

RoadOcc Learns When to Persist, Transport, or Refresh Memory for Roadside Occupancy Prediction Perception3D

occupancy prediction temporal memory motion compensation dynamic-aware cross-attention velocity estimation

简要说明：RoadOcc 通过学习在固定坐标历史、速度寻址历史和当前证据之间进行软路由，改进了路边占用预测，在 InfraOcc 上达到了最先进水平。

TLDR: RoadOcc improves roadside occupancy prediction by learning to route memory sources among fixed-coordinate history, velocity-addressed history, and current evidence, achieving state-of-the-art on InfraOcc.

Abstract: Fixed roadside cameras repeatedly observe a stable scene overlaid by sparse moving traffic. Temporal memory can recover weak observations, but reusing moving evidence at stale locations can corrupt occupancy predictions. Motion compensation addresses displacement, while reliance on the resulting history remains a separate learning problem. We introduce RoadOcc, which learns soft routing among fixed-coordinate history (\emph{Persist}), velocity-addressed history (\emph{Transport}), and current evidence (\emph{Refresh}). Motion state and class-consistent historical support supervise these source choices. Dynamic-aware cross-attention (DCA) updates candidate locations, multi-scale voxel velocity estimation (VVE) constructs transport addresses from multi-scale current--history correspondence, and velocity-guided dynamic sparse fusion (VDSF) combines routed evidence under fixed sparse-token budgets. On InfraOcc, RoadOcc reaches 65.29 mIoU and 32.37 dynamic mIoU, gains of 4.44 and 4.71 over STCOcc. Controlled address experiments show that VVE raises dynamic mIoU by 0.87 over fixed-coordinate reading. Across three seeds, supervised P/T/R adds 1.40 dynamic points over motion-corrected retrieval, while removing Refresh costs 0.32 points. Results from two transfer models, Occ3D-nuScenes, and longer intervals provide additional support. Code will be released.

摘要（中文）：固定式路侧摄像头反复观测由稀疏移动交通所覆盖的稳定场景。时间记忆能够恢复弱观测信息，但在过时位置复用移动证据可能会破坏占用预测的准确性。运动补偿解决了位移问题，而如何依赖由此产生的历史信息仍是一个独立的学习问题。我们提出了RoadOcc方法，该方法在固定坐标历史（\emph{Persist}）、速度寻址历史（\emph{Transport}）和当前证据（\emph{Refresh}）之间学习软路由机制。运动状态和类别一致的历史支持对上述来源选择进行监督。动态感知交叉注意力（DCA）更新候选位置，多尺度体素速度估计（VVE）通过多尺度当前-历史对应关系构建传输地址，速度引导的动态稀疏融合（VDSF）在固定稀疏令牌预算下融合路由后的证据。在InfraOcc数据集上，RoadOcc达到65.29 mIoU和32.37动态mIoU，较STCOcc分别提升4.44和4.71。受控地址实验表明，相较于固定坐标读取，VVE将动态mIoU提升了0.87。在三种随机种子下，受监督的P/T/R较运动校正检索额外提升1.40个动态百分点，而移除Refresh则损失0.32个百分点。来自两个迁移模型、Occ3D-nuScenes数据集以及更长时间间隔的实验结果提供了进一步的支持。代码将公开发布。

Authors: Xiaokai Bai, Lei Yang, Songkai Wang, Lianqing Zheng, Si-Yuan Cao, Hui-liang Shen

Full-Covariance Smoothing of Bayesian Neural Networks for Online Adaptation VLA

Bayesian neural networks smoothing full-covariance online adaptation vision-language-action model

简要说明：本文提出了一种全协方差平滑方法用于贝叶斯神经网络，实现了无梯度的闭式在线自适应，并在非平稳分类、在线动力学学习以及视觉-语言-行动模型的策略自适应中展示了更高的准确性。

TLDR: The paper introduces a full-covariance smoothing method for Bayesian neural networks, enabling closed-form, online adaptation without gradients, and demonstrates improved accuracy in non-stationary classification, online dynamics learning, and policy adaptation of a vision-language-action model.

Abstract: A neural network's layers can be treated as time steps of a state-space model, turning Bayesian training into a smoothing problem: a forward pass propagates Gaussian moments through the network, and a backward Rauch--Tung--Striebel pass updates the weight posteriors in closed form. Such methods learn from each observation in a single pass, in an uncertainty-aware manner, and without gradient-based iterations or replay, which makes them well suited for online adaptation and data-efficient learning. Existing smoothing-based methods, however, are restricted to diagonal covariances across activations, discarding correlations between neurons. We overcome this limitation via a cross-covariance identity that enables full-covariance propagation through a network's nonlinear activations. We derive a one-step-per-layer smoother that approximates as Gaussian only each layer's affine output, and that applies both to deterministic systems with noisy observations and to stochastic systems described by output statistics. We demonstrate this method in non-stationary classification, online dynamics learning, and policy adaptation of a vision-language-action model, and find that it is generally more accurate than other smoothing-based methods.

摘要（中文）：神经网络中的各层可以被视为状态空间模型中的时间步长，从而将贝叶斯训练转化为一个平滑问题：前向传播通过网络传递高斯矩，后向Rauch--Tung--Striebel传播则以闭式形式更新权重后验。此类方法在单次遍历中即可根据每个观测进行学习，具有不确定性感知特性，且无需基于梯度的迭代或回放，因此非常适合在线自适应和数据高效学习。然而，现有的基于平滑的方法仅限于激活值之间的对角协方差，忽略了神经元之间的相关性。我们通过一个交叉协方差恒等式克服了这一限制，该恒等式使得全协方差能够通过网络中的非线性激活函数进行传播。我们推导出一种每层单步的平滑器，该平滑器仅将每一层的仿射输出近似为高斯分布，并且同时适用于具有噪声观测的确定性系统以及由输出统计量描述的随机系统。我们在非平稳分类、在线动力学学习以及视觉-语言-动作模型的策略自适应中验证了该方法，并发现其在总体上比其他基于平滑的方法具有更高的准确性。

Authors: Oren Wright, Haoming Jing, Qiaoan Shen, Koichiro Niinuma, Yorie Nakahira, José M. F. Moura

Tractable Reinforcement Learning for Full Class of Signal Temporal Logic Specifications Using Spatiotemporal Tube Reward RLRobot

Signal Temporal Logic Temporal Logic Control Soft Actor-Critic Robotic Control Input Constraints

简要说明：本文提出一种利用时空管奖励的时间感知强化学习框架，用于在未知动力学和输入约束下满足信号时序逻辑规范的机器人系统，避免了执行时显式评估逻辑语义。

TLDR: This paper proposes a time-aware reinforcement learning framework using spatiotemporal tube rewards to satisfy Signal Temporal Logic specifications for robotic systems with unknown dynamics and input constraints, avoiding explicit logical semantic evaluation during execution.

Abstract: This paper addresses the control problem for robotic systems, including non-holonomic and underactuated platforms operating under unknown dynamics and strict actuator limits to satisfy complex high-level specifications. We denote these high-level specifications using Signal Temporal Logic (STL) and propose a novel time-aware Reinforcement Learning (RL) framework that leverages the geometric properties of Spatiotemporal Tubes (STTs). While traditional analytical STT controllers often struggle to enforce input constraints, and existing RL approaches rely on memory-intensive state history, our method natively overcomes both limitations. By mapping the logical and temporal complexities of the full class of STL into time-varying geometric boundaries, we directly constrain the multidimensional system state without relying on scalar robustness metrics. Augmenting the state space with time, we train a time-aware Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) agent using a continuous, geometry-aware reward function that eliminates the need to explicitly evaluate complex logical semantics during execution. The proposed framework offers a history-free, computationally efficient approach to learn continuous control policies that ensure robust satisfaction of specifications while strictly adhering to system input constraints.

摘要（中文）：本文针对机器人系统的控制问题展开研究，涵盖在未知动力学和严格执行器限制条件下运行的非完整及欠驱动平台，以满足复杂的高层规格要求。我们采用信号时序逻辑（STL）对这些高层规格进行形式化描述，并提出一种新颖的具时感知强化学习（RL）框架，利用时空管（STT）的几何特性进行控制策略学习。传统解析型STT控制器在施加输入约束方面往往存在困难，而现有强化学习方法则依赖高内存开销的状态历史信息；本文方法天然克服了上述两方面的局限。通过将完整STL类别的逻辑复杂性和时间复杂性映射为时变几何边界，我们直接对多维系统状态施加约束，而无需依赖标量鲁棒性度量。通过在状态空间中引入时间维度，我们利用连续且具几何感知的奖励函数训练了一个具时感知的软演员-评论家（SAC）智能体，从而在执行过程中免去了对复杂逻辑语义的显式评估需求。所提出的框架提供了一种无需历史信息、计算高效的方法，用于学习连续控制策略，以确保规格的鲁棒满足并严格遵循系统输入约束。

Authors: Vaishnavi Jagabathula, P Sangeerth, Pushpak Jagtap

Amplify: A Lightweight Library for Reproducible Nonlinear Programming Problems in Robotics Other

nonlinear programming trajectory optimization reproducibility constraint-based formulation

简要说明：Amplify是一个轻量级非线性规划库，将轨迹优化算法编码为优化模型中的约束，旨在实现双足运动和抓取规划等机器人问题的可复现性。

TLDR: Amplify is a lightweight nonlinear programming library that encodes trajectory optimization algorithms as constraints within optimization models, aiming for reproducibility in robotic problems such as bipedal locomotion and grasp planning.

Abstract: Optimization problems (OPs) are key to solving many challenging research problems in robotics. However, reproducibility still remains a major issue. In this paper, we present Amplify, a lightweight nonlinear programming library aimed at reproducible results of robotic-related trajectory optimization problems. The minimalistic requirements for the 537-line library (80 characters per line) are an Internet connection, familiarity with the AMPL modeling language, and a text editor. Our primary contribution is the formulation of a library where trajectory optimization algorithms are represented directly within the optimization model. Specifically, we implement the algorithms used to compute the dynamics, trajectories, and reference motions as constraints of the OP in a declarative programming paradigm. We outline how our formulation of objectives, decisions variables, and constraints can be implemented in other transcription libraries that want to be lightweight and reproducible. We also compare the Amplify framework with 3 other libraries across examples of benchmark optimization problems across several fields, including bipedal locomotion and grasp planning.

摘要（中文）：优化问题（OPs）是解决机器人学中诸多挑战性研究问题的关键。然而，可复现性仍是一个主要难题。本文介绍Amplify，一个轻量级非线性规划库，旨在实现机器人相关轨迹优化问题的可复现结果。该库仅由537行代码（每行80个字符）构成，其最低要求仅为具备网络连接、熟悉AMPL建模语言以及拥有一个文本编辑器。我们的主要贡献在于构建了一个将轨迹优化算法直接表示在优化模型中的库。具体而言，我们采用声明式编程范式，将用于计算动力学、轨迹和参考运动的算法作为优化问题的约束条件来实现。我们概述了目标函数、决策变量和约束条件的公式化方法，该方法可应用于其他希望实现轻量化和可复现性的转录库中。我们还将Amplify框架与其他3个库在多个领域的基准优化问题示例上进行了比较，包括双足 locomotion 和抓取规划。

Authors: Nelson Rosa

Multimodal Voice Activity Projection for Social Robot Mediation: Expected Behavior and Deployment Constraints Other

Voice Activity Projection Social Robot Mediation Turn-taking Prediction Multimodal Perception Deployment Constraints

简要说明：本文提出MM-VAP，一种多模态感知模型，利用音视频编码器、LoRA适应和零样本事件推断来预测人机对话中的话轮转换事件，用于社交机器人调解，并讨论实时推理和同步等部署约束。

TLDR: This paper introduces MM-VAP, a multimodal perception model that predicts turn-taking events in human-human conversations for social robot mediators, using audio-visual encoders, LoRA adaptation, and zero-shot event inference, with a focus on deployment constraints such as real-time inference and synchronization.

Abstract: Turn-taking prediction is especially relevant for social robots that act as mediators in human-human interaction, where the expected action is often not to speak, but to orient, wait, avoid interruption, or prepare a balanced intervention. This paper presents Multimodal Voice Activity Projection (MM-VAP) as a human state-aware perception layer for future robot mediation behavior. The model estimates the future evolution of the conversational floor from synchronized audio-visual evidence and derives turn-taking events such as Hold, Shift, Shift prediction, Backchannel prediction, and overlap-related states. The approach uses VA-related pretrained audio-visual encoders, LoRA adaptation, inter-speaker attention, and zero-shot event inference from future voice activity projections. Experiments on NoXi, NoXi+J, and Haru EDR support the feasibility of this formulation, especially for floor management events that can be connected to gaze preparation, active listening, and conservative intervention. Finally, the paper defines the expected robot output interface and discusses the main deployment constraints, including real-time inference, preprocessing latency, multimodal synchronization, and input-quality monitoring.

摘要（中文）：话轮转换预测对于在人际交互中充当调解人的社交机器人尤为重要，在这类场景中，预期动作通常不是发言，而是调整方向、等待、避免打断或准备平衡的介入。本文提出多模态语音活动投影（MM-VAP），作为未来机器人调解行为中一种具备人类状态感知能力的感知层。该模型根据同步的音视频证据估计会话空间的未来演变，并推导出话轮转换事件，如保持、转换、转换预测、反馈预测及重叠相关状态。该方法采用基于语音活动相关的预训练音视频编码器、LoRA适配、说话者间注意力机制，以及基于未来语音活动投影的零样本事件推断。在NoXi、NoXi+J和Haru EDR上的实验支持了这一公式的可行性，尤其是对于可与凝视准备、积极倾听和保守介入相关联的空间管理事件。最后，本文定义了预期的机器人输出接口，并讨论了主要的部署约束条件，包括实时推理、预处理延迟、多模态同步和输入质量监控。

Authors: Antonio Cano, Guillermo Perez, Luis Merino, Randy Gomez

Large-Scale Geometric Map-Based Localization of UAVs in GNSS-Denied Urban Environments RLRobot

geometry-driven descriptor UAV localization GNSS-denied building footprint matching vision-based localization

简要说明：一种在GNSS拒止环境下，通过几何描述符将无人机下视相机观测到的建筑物模式与参考足迹数据库匹配，在大范围搜索区域内实现高召回率的定位系统。

TLDR: A GNSS-denied UAV localization system that matches building patterns from downward-facing cameras against reference footprint databases using geometry-driven descriptors, achieving high recall over large search areas.

Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) operating in GNSS-denied urban environments require alternative methods for position estimation. Existing approaches based on satellite image retrieval or learned descriptors are sensitive to appearance variation and degrade rapidly as the search area grows. We present a vision-based localization system that matches building patterns observed from a downward-facing UAV camera against a reference building footprint database. Our approach detects buildings in aerial imagery, accumulates observations across frames into a unified map, and matches local building arrangements against reference footprints using a novel geometry-driven descriptor that augments local triangle structure with per-building shape features. By encoding spatial relationships between nearby buildings rather than visual appearance, the system is robust to appearance variations and remains discriminative over large search areas. Evaluations on seven flights across four municipalities in a large metropolitan area demonstrate 100% Recall@1 at search areas of approximately 113 km$^2$ and 254 km$^2$, and 71.4% Recall@1 when expanded to approximately 452 km$^2$, encompassing up to 277,000 buildings. In contrast, baseline methods degrade rapidly and achieve 0% Recall@1 at 254 km$^2$ and 452 km$^2$.

摘要（中文）：在GNSS拒止的城市环境中运行的无人机需要替代性的位置估计方法。现有基于卫星图像检索或学习描述符的方法对表观变化敏感，且随着搜索区域扩大性能迅速下降。我们提出了一种基于视觉的定位系统，该系统将无人机下视相机观测到的建筑模式与参考建筑足迹数据库进行匹配。我们的方法在航空影像中检测建筑，将跨帧观测累积到统一地图中，并利用一种新颖的几何驱动描述符将局部建筑布局与参考足迹进行匹配，该描述符在局部三角形结构上增强了每栋建筑的形状特征。通过编码邻近建筑之间的空间关系而非视觉表观，该系统对表观变化具有鲁棒性，并在大范围搜索区域内保持判别能力。在覆盖大都市区四个市镇的七次飞行评估中，系统在约113 km²和254 km²的搜索区域内实现了100%的Recall@1，在扩展至约452 km²（涵盖多达277,000栋建筑）时达到71.4%的Recall@1。相比之下，基线方法性能迅速下降，在254 km²和452 km²搜索区域内Recall@1为0%。

Authors: Garth Terlizzi, Kaveh Fathian

GLASS: Architecture-Tuned, Composable, Device-Side Linear Algebra for Edge Robotics and Beyond Other

CUDA C++ library linear algebra edge robotics embedded systems GPU optimization

简要说明：GLASS 是一个仅头文件的 CUDA C++ 库，为边缘机器人提供可组合且针对架构调优的线性代数，相比 PyTorch/JAX 实现了显著加速，并将已发布机器人系统的嵌入式运行时间提升高达 1.5 倍。

TLDR: GLASS is a header-only CUDA C++ library providing composable, architecture-tuned linear algebra for edge robotics, achieving significant speedups over PyTorch/JAX and improving embedded runtimes of published robotics systems.

Abstract: GPU robotics lacks the reusable numerical infrastructure of mature CPU stacks, instead relying on compiler frameworks that introduce overhead or repeatedly reimplementing numerical libraries. To address this, we introduce GLASS (GPU Linear Algebra Simple Subroutines), a header-only CUDA C++ library that provides thread-, warp-, block-, and NVIDIA-backed implementations of robotics-scale linear algebra and geometric computations under one composable device API. GLASS treats implementation choice, execution scope, and launch packing as architecture-specific placement decisions determined by offline measurement and resolved statically at compile time. This is critical as the best and worst placements differ by a median of 4.9x (max 81x), with 145 of 396 recommended placements changing between a Jetson AGX Orin and an RTX 5090, and 162 of 396 versus an AGX Xavier. These stakes are highest at the edge as GLASS's advantage over the best of PyTorch and JAX is as much as 73x on the Orin versus 12x on the RTX 5090. GLASS is released open source with independent numerical oracles and source-bound local-GPU test attestation. Finally, integrating GLASS with published robotics systems both exposed a pre-existing numerical bug and improved embedded runtimes by up to 1.5x.

摘要（中文）：GPU机器人领域缺乏成熟CPU技术栈所具有的可复用数值基础设施，转而依赖会引入开销的编译器框架或反复重新实现数值库。为解决这一问题，我们提出GLASS（GPU线性代数简单子程序），这是一个仅含头文件的CUDA C++库，在线程、线程束、线程块及NVIDIA支持的层面提供机器人规模线性代数与几何计算实现，并统一于一个可组合的设备API之下。GLASS将实现选择、执行范围和启动打包视为由离线测量决定、并在编译时静态解析的架构特定放置决策。这一点至关重要，因为最佳与最差放置之间的性能差异中位数达4.9倍（最大81倍），在Jetson AGX Orin与RTX 5090之间，396个推荐放置中有145个发生变化，而与AGX Xavier相比则有162个发生变化。这些差异在边缘设备上影响最大：GLASS在Orin上相较于PyTorch和JAX最优方案的性能优势高达73倍，而在RTX 5090上仅为12倍。GLASS已开源发布，附带独立的数值验证源和基于本地GPU的源绑定测试证明。最后，将GLASS集成到已发表的机器人系统中，不仅暴露了一个先前存在的数值错误，还将嵌入式运行时性能提升了最高1.5倍。

Authors: Brian Plancher

Dynamic, Decentralized Spatial Code Reuse for OCDMA LiDAR in Robot Swarms Other

decentralized protocol spatial code reuse OCDMA LiDAR robot swarms code-assignment scaling

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于机器人蜂群中OCDMA LiDAR的分散式动态空间码复用协议，证明了在恒定机器人密度下所需码数按O(log N/log log N)增长，相比静态分配有无限改进，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证了该方法在码复用效率和碰撞风险降低方面的显著优势。

TLDR: This paper proposes a decentralized, dynamic spatial code reuse protocol for OCDMA LiDAR in robot swarms, proving that the required number of codes grows as O(log N/log log N) under constant robot density, an unbounded improvement over static assignment, and validates the approach through Monte Carlo simulations showing substantial gains in code-reuse efficiency and reduced collision risk.

Abstract: Robots in a LiDAR-equipped swarm mutually interfere when their optical ranging codes collide. Existing mitigations either assign codes statically -- requiring $L=N$ distinguishable codes for $N$ robots -- or react to detected interference without a scalable, coordinated assignment rule beneath them; prior work explicitly identifies the code-assignment scaling problem as unsolved. We propose a decentralized protocol in which robots dynamically reassign spatial reuse codes based on a live, beacon-maintained interference-neighborhood graph, and prove that the number of codes required grows as $O(\log N/\log\log N)$ under constant robot density -- an unbounded improvement over the $Θ(N)$ growth of static assignment. We validate this result under conditions substantially beyond the idealized proof -- robot mobility, imperfect beacon-based detection, and reactive reassignment -- via Monte Carlo simulation (30 seeds per condition, 95% confidence intervals): the advantage over static assignment widens from roughly $2\times$ at 15 robots to $12\times$ at 120. Against a structurally faithful, fairly constructed model of an existing coordination-free approach, our protocol achieves both substantially greater code-reuse efficiency and 30--40% lower collision risk under an identical, constrained code budget, demonstrating that coordination -- not merely reactivity -- is what closes the scaling gap.

摘要（中文）：配备激光雷达的机器人群体在光学测距码发生碰撞时会产生相互干扰。现有缓解方案要么静态分配编码——对于$N$个机器人需要$L=N$个可区分编码——要么对检测到的干扰做出反应，但缺乏可扩展的、协调一致的分配规则作为底层支撑；已有工作明确将编码分配的可扩展性问题视为未解难题。我们提出一种去中心化协议，机器人基于实时维护的信标干扰邻域图动态重新分配空间复用编码，并证明在恒定机器人密度下所需编码数量按$O(\log N/\log\log N)$增长——相较于静态分配的$Θ(N)$增长，这是无界改进。我们在远超理想化证明条件的场景下验证了这一结果——包括机器人移动性、基于信标检测的不完美性以及反应式重新分配——通过蒙特卡洛模拟（每种条件30个随机种子，95%置信区间）：相较于静态分配的优势从15个机器人时的约$2$倍扩大到120个机器人时的$12$倍。针对一种结构忠实、公平构建的现有免协调方案模型，在相同且受限的编码预算下，我们的协议同时实现了显著更高的编码复用效率和低30%—40%的碰撞风险，证明协调——而非仅反应式处理——才是弥合扩展差距的关键。

Authors: Mohammad Hani Alomari

DAVIO: Dense Monocular-Inertial SLAM with Feed-Forward Initialization and Pose-Conditioned Mapping Perception3D

dense metric SLAM visual-inertial feed-forward depth pose-conditioned mapping real-time

简要说明：DAVIO 是一个实时稠密度量 SLAM 系统，结合前馈多视图深度模型与视觉惯性滤波器，实现早期初始化和基于位姿条件的稠密建图，用于度量定位。

TLDR: DAVIO is a real-time dense metric SLAM system that combines a feed-forward multi-view depth model with a visual-inertial filter, enabling early initialization and pose-conditioned dense mapping for metric localization.

Abstract: A camera and an IMU are the minimal sensor setup for metric localization and dense mapping, yet classical visual--inertial filters must wait for parallax before they start and then retain only sparse landmarks. Feed-forward geometry models, in contrast, predict dense structure from a few images but provide neither metric scale nor gravity. We present DAVIO, which uses a single multi-view depth model, Depth Anything~3, for both start-up and mapping. At start-up, a five-image window and preintegrated IMU measurements form a feature-free linear system. Its robust, conditioning-checked solution bootstraps a VIO filter through buffered replay. During tracking, the filter's metric poses condition the depth model. Residual scale is corrected only along viewing rays, which preserves the metric camera baselines, and a gravity-preserving submap graph with drift-gated revisits refines the map. On EuRoC, DAVIO starts markedly earlier, reduces the localization error, and maps more accurately than SOTA feed-forward mappers given identical poses. On building-scale ORI sequences, DAVIO is on bar or better than SOTA mappers on the same odometry, and degrades far less when GT poses are replaced by real odometry. We release the code of DAVIO, a real-time dense metric SLAM system, to the community.

摘要（中文）：摘要：相机与IMU是进行度量定位与稠密建图的最小传感器配置，然而经典的视觉-惯性滤波器必须等待视差产生后才能启动，且仅能保留稀疏地标。相比之下，前馈几何模型可从少量图像预测稠密结构，但既不提供度量尺度也不提供重力方向。我们提出了DAVIO系统，其使用单一的多视角深度模型——Depth Anything 3——同时完成启动与建图任务。在启动阶段，由五帧图像窗口与预积分的IMU测量构成一个无特征线性系统，其鲁棒且经过条件数检验的解通过缓冲重放引导视觉-惯性滤波器（VIO）完成初始化。在跟踪过程中，滤波器的度量位姿对深度模型进行条件约束，残余尺度仅沿观测射线方向进行修正，从而保持度量相机基线的正确性；同时，采用保留重力方向的子地图图结构，并引入漂移门控的回访机制对地图进行优化。在EuRoc数据集上，DAVIO的启动时间显著提前，定位误差更低，且在相同位姿输入下，其建图精度优于目前最先进的前馈建图方法。在建筑规模的ORI序列上，DAVIO与基于相同里程计的最先进建图方法性能相当或更优，当将真实位姿替换为实际里程计结果时，其性能退化程度远小于对比方法。我们将DAVIO——这一实时稠密度量SLAM系统的代码开源，供社区使用。

Authors: Jaafar Mahmoud, Arthur Movsesyan, Mikhail Iumanov, Sergey Kolyubin

Gray-Box Model Predictive Control for Articulated Dump Trucks via Gaussian Process Learning of Sideslip AutonomousDriving

Gaussian Process Regression Model Predictive Control sideslip angle gray-box model articulated dump truck

简要说明：本文通过高斯过程回归学习铰接式卡车的侧偏角，并将其融入运动学模型形成灰盒模型用于MPC，在仿真中将最大横向跟踪误差从2米以上降至0.56米。

TLDR: This paper integrates Gaussian Process Regression into a kinematic model of an articulated dump truck to learn the sideslip angle, forming a gray-box model for MPC that significantly reduces lateral tracking error compared to white-box MPCs in simulation.

Abstract: The growing demand for automation in the mining industry, particularly for the autonomous operation of articulated dump trucks (ADTs), has drawn increased attention to accurate vehicle modeling. The importance of such models lies in their use in model predictive control (MPC), model-based estimation methods, and vehicle simulation. While dynamic modeling offers a viable solution for these purposes, it is associated with complex setup and parametrization and may require recalibration in changing operating environments. As a result, kinematic models have dominated ADT modeling, especially in MPCs, at the expense of reduced prediction accuracy. In this work, we propose an approach using Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) to learn the sideslip angle of the vehicle, which is identified as the primary contributor to the reduced accuracy of kinematic models. The learned GPR function is augmented into the kinematic model to form a gray-box model that aims to reduce the gap to dynamic models. We show that the gray-box model can predict the sideslip angle and, consequently, the vehicle's lateral velocity, thereby improving the MPC's prediction performance. The resulting gray-box MPC is compared against two white-box MPCs in a simulation environment. The results indicate an improvement in terms of maximum lateral tracking error from over 2 m to 0.56 m.

摘要（中文）：采矿业对自动化需求的日益增长，特别是对铰接式自卸卡车（ADTs）自主运行的需求，使得精确的车辆建模受到更多关注。此类模型的重要性在于其在模型预测控制（MPC）、基于模型的估计方法以及车辆仿真中的应用。尽管动力学建模为这些用途提供了可行的解决方案，但其涉及复杂的设置和参数标定，并且可能在变化的运行环境中需要重新校准。因此，运动学模型在ADT建模中占据主导地位，尤其是在MPC中，但代价是预测精度的降低。在本工作中，我们提出了一种使用高斯过程回归（GPR）学习车辆侧偏角的方法，该侧偏角被认为是导致运动学模型精度下降的主要因素。将学习得到的GPR函数增强到运动学模型中，形成一个灰箱模型，旨在缩小与动力学模型之间的差距。我们展示了该灰箱模型能够预测侧偏角，进而预测车辆的横向速度，从而提升MPC的预测性能。在仿真环境中，将由此得到的灰箱MPC与两个白箱MPC进行了比较。结果表明，最大横向跟踪误差从超过2米改善至0.56米。

Authors: Arash Shahirpour, Jens Ahlers, Christopher Schulte, Tim Reuscher

Action-Directed Information for Distributed Control and Agentic Interaction Locomotion

action-directed information distributed control embodied plant peer-sensor predictive estimator

简要说明：本文提出一种面向行动的信息度量方法用于分布式控制，并在模拟四肢体具身植物上测试，表明在故障条件下同伴传感器控制可提升跟踪性能。

TLDR: The paper introduces an action-directed information measure for distributed control, tested on a simulated embodied four-limb plant, showing peer-sensor control improves tracking under failure via a predictive estimator.

Abstract: Distributed intelligence concerns systems in which semi-autonomous components with local dynamics and partial observations coordinate through information exchange to maintain a shared function. This paper proposes an operational way to study such systems: measure information at the interface where a message changes a receiving action, then connect that measure to function by intervention and disturbance evaluation. We instantiate this proposal in DI-Walker, a two-dimensional four-limb embodied plant controlled by frozen Cross-Entropy-Method policies. We compare a controller using each limb's own realized-force sensor with one using the realized-force sensors of peer limbs. Under limb loss, limb slip, and weak central-control dropout, Peer-Sensor has lower late tracking error in several conditions. A corrected finite-history action-predictive estimator shows a substantially larger peer-message gain under compound failure. A future scalar functional-prediction estimator does not show the same stable advantage. We interpret this discrepancy as a methodological result: information useful for an intermediate control action can be hidden by later plant dynamics, redundancy, and context. The paper relates this result to Predictive Information, Transfer Entropy, Directed Information, information-to-go/IT-PAC ideas, empowerment, and the robust control data-rate perspective, while explicitly distinguishing operational predictive gains from exact Directed Information, channel capacity, and a formal data-rate theorem.

摘要（中文）：摘要：分布式智能关注这样一类系统：其中具有局部动力学和部分观测的半自主组件通过信息交换进行协调，以维持共享功能。本文提出一种研究此类系统的操作性方法：在消息改变接收方行为的信息界面上度量信息，然后通过干预和扰动评估将该度量与功能联系起来。我们将这一方案实例化为DI-Walker，一个由冻结的交叉熵方法策略控制的二维四肢具身植物。我们比较了使用每条肢体自身实际力传感器的控制器与使用同伴肢体实际力传感器的控制器。在肢体缺失、肢体打滑和中央控制弱中断条件下，Peer-Sensor在若干情形中具有更低的后期跟踪误差。经过校正的有限历史动作预测估计器在复合故障下显示出显著更大的同伴消息增益。而未来的标量功能预测估计器未显示出同样稳定的优势。我们将这一差异解释为方法论结果：对中间控制动作有用的信息可能被后续的植物动力学、冗余和上下文所掩盖。本文将这一结果与预测信息、转移熵、有向信息、信息余量/IT-PAC思想、赋权以及鲁棒控制数据率视角相关联，同时明确区分操作性预测增益与精确有向信息、信道容量和形式化数据率定理。

Authors: Shlomo Dubnov

Safety-Filtered Distributed Koopman-MPC Other

distributed MPC Koopman operator safety filter multi-robot warehouse collision avoidance

简要说明：本文提出一种安全过滤的分布式Koopman-MPC方法，用于多机器人仓库导航，通过局部传感和货架几何定义硬约束二次规划投影，在数据包丢失情况下保证无碰撞控制，并在仿真中验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a safety-filtered distributed Koopman-MPC method for multi-robot warehouse navigation, where local sensing and shelf geometry define a hard QP projection to guarantee collision-free control even with packet loss, validated in simulation.

Abstract: Distributed model predictive control (DMPC) often constructs both predictions and collision constraints from neighbor trajectories, so packet loss can remove both. We separate these roles: received trajectories drive Koopman-MPC, while local sensing and shelf geometry define a hard-constrained quadratic program (QP) that projects the applied input. Its radial demand is the least constant acceleration that keeps a supporting-plane clearance nonnegative throughout one zero-order-hold interval. Complementary pair rows recover the coupled demand without exchanging safety decisions. We give an intersample separation theorem under bounded snapshot and directional plant errors, an exact max-min test for simultaneous local feasibility, and a sensing-radius condition for switching interaction graphs. Anticipatory high-order rows may be relaxed for performance, but the finite-hold rows contain no safety slack. Matched eight-robot warehouse simulations use a frozen Koopman model, nonlinear drift, bounded inputs and speed, shelf constraints, a 120 ms control period, and packet dropout. The full controller is collision-free in 20/20 matched trials and reaches 160/160 robot goals; predictive Koopman-MPC without the final projection is collision-free in 1/20 trials. All 38,400 full-method hard-row sets pass the online feasibility test, and every local QP solves. Five-stream fleet sweeps are collision-free and hard-row feasible through 16 robots; the 20-robot boundary fails only after the online margin turns negative, while the reconstructed per-agent critical path remains below the sampling period. Bounded-sensing and differential-drive tests provide additional deployment stress.

摘要（中文）：分布式模型预测控制（DMPC）通常同时从邻居轨迹构建预测模型和碰撞约束，因此数据包丢失可能同时导致两者失效。本文将这两种功能分离：接收到的轨迹驱动Koopman-MPC，而局部感知与货架几何结构则定义一个带硬约束的二次规划（QP）来投影实际施加的输入。其径向需求是在整个零阶保持区间内保持支撑平面间隙非负所需的最小恒定加速度。互补成对行在不交换安全决策的情况下恢复耦合需求。本文给出了在快照误差和有向被控对象误差有界条件下的采样间分离定理、同时局部可行性的精确极大极小检验，以及切换交互图的感知半径条件。前瞻性高阶行可因性能需求而松弛，但有限保持行不包含任何安全裕度。匹配的八机器人仓库仿真采用冻结的Koopman模型、非线性漂移、有界输入与速度、货架约束、120毫秒控制周期及数据包丢失设置。完整控制器在20/20次匹配试验中无碰撞，并达成160/160个机器人目标；而未经最终投影的预测性Koopman-MPC仅在1/20次试验中无碰撞。全部38,400组完整方法硬约束行均通过在线可行性检验，且每个局部QP均可求解。五流道编队清扫在16台机器人内均无碰撞且满足硬约束行可行性；20台机器人边界仅在在线裕度变为负值后才失效，而重构的每智能体关键路径仍低于采样周期。有界感知与差速驱动测试提供了额外的部署压力测试。

Authors: Shengjun Zhang, Wenhao Li, Zhenxin Lin, Zhenglong Sun

Geometry-Conditioned Visual Place Recognition in Natural Environments Perception3D

Visual Place Recognition Depth-Aware Distillation Geometric Foundation Model Vision Foundation Model Natural Environments

简要说明：该论文提出了深度感知蒸馏（DAD）方法，利用几何基础模型推断的几何信息调制视觉基础模型的令牌表示，以提升自然环境中视觉位置识别的性能，在WildCross基准上显著提高了Recall@1和Recall@5。

TLDR: The paper presents Depth-Aware Distillation (DAD), a method that conditions a Vision Foundation Model's token representations on geometry from a Geometric Foundation Model to improve Visual Place Recognition in natural environments, achieving significant Recall@1 and Recall@5 gains on the WildCross benchmark.

Abstract: Visual Place Recognition (VPR) in natural environments remains challenging due to repetitive vegetation, sparse distinctive landmarks, and substantial appearance and viewpoint variation across traversals. While visual observations of the same place can change considerably, their underlying spatial structure is often more persistent. We exploit this complementary geometric consistency through Depth-Aware Distillation (DAD), which conditions the token representations of a pretrained Vision Foundation Model (VFM) on geometry inferred by a Geometric Foundation Model (GFM), without any depth sensor. Rather than treating geometry as an additional input modality, DAD projects image-aligned depth into the VFM token space and selectively modulates visual representations through channel-wise geometric conditioning. A two-stage teacher-guided learning strategy first anchors the geometry-conditioned representation to the pretrained appearance space, before refining it for place discrimination. Evaluated on the WildCross benchmark, DAD improves average inter-sequence Recall@1 from 61.41% to 66.37% and Recall@5 from 65.86% to 72.49% over a matched appearance-only baseline, with the largest gains under reverse traversal and long-term appearance variation. These results show that GFM-derived geometry can provide a persistent structural prior for VPR when visual appearance becomes unreliable.

摘要（中文）：自然环境中的视觉地点识别任务因植被重复、显著地标稀疏以及跨遍历时外观和视角的大幅变化而依然充满挑战。尽管同一地点的视觉观测可能发生显著变化，但其潜在的几何空间结构往往更具持续性。我们通过深度感知蒸馏方法，利用这种互补的几何一致性，在不依赖任何深度传感器的情况下，将预训练视觉基础模型的令牌表示条件化于几何基础模型推断出的几何信息之上。深度感知蒸馏并未将几何信息作为额外的输入模态，而是将图像对齐的深度映射至VFM令牌空间，并通过通道级几何条件调制选择性地调整视觉表示。一种两阶段的教师引导学习策略，首先将几何条件化表示锚定至预训练的外观空间，随后再针对地点判别进行精化。在WildCross基准上的评估显示，与匹配的仅外观基线相比，深度感知蒸馏将平均序列间Recall@1从61.41%提升至66.37%，将Recall@5从65.86%提升至72.49%，在反向遍历和长期外观变化情形下取得了最大的提升。这些结果表明，当视觉外观变得不可靠时，GFM导出的几何信息能够为视觉地点识别提供一种持续的结构性先验。

Authors: Walter Nedov, Saimunur Rahman, Kavindie Katuwandeniya, David Hall, Kaushik Roy, Peyman Moghadam

From LiDAR Maps to Visual Localization: Unified Visual Association for Robust Point-Line-Plane Pose Estimation Perception3D

visual localization LiDAR map point-line-plane pose estimation cross-modal matching observability-complementary optimization

简要说明：该论文提出了一个统一的视觉定位框架，将LiDAR地图渲染为准图像，利用成熟的视觉特征和匹配器实现相机与LiDAR的鲁棒匹配，并通过分布感知优化来处理模糊关联，实现精确的6自由度位姿估计。

TLDR: This paper presents a unified visual localization framework that renders LiDAR maps into quasi-images, enabling camera-LiDAR matching via mature visual features and matchers for robust 6-DoF pose estimation, with a distribution-aware optimization to handle ambiguous associations.

Abstract: Camera localization in a prior LiDAR map provides a persistent geometric reference for long-term robotic navigation, yet remains challenging because of the substantial modality gap between camera images and point-cloud maps. We present a unified localization framework that makes the LiDAR map visually addressable rather than relying on a dedicated image-LiDAR correspondence model. Map geometry and reflectivity are rendered into LiDAR-derived quasi-images with explicit 2D-3D provenance, enabling camera observations and rendered map views to share mature visual features and matchers for both global localization and continuous pose tracking. Point and line correspondences are established through this common visual interface, while the retained provenance recovers metric LiDAR geometry and line-supported planar constraints for pose estimation. To improve robustness under ambiguous associations and weak geometry, we further introduce a distribution-aware, observability-complementary optimization strategy. Instead of reducing matching ambiguity to a scalar confidence, candidate association distributions are propagated into directional pose-information uncertainty, and reliable structural factors are selectively reinforced according to their ability to complement the currently weak pose directions. Experiments on the EuRoC MAV benchmark and self-collected real-world sequences demonstrate accurate global localization and robust continuous 6-DoF tracking using only a pre-built LiDAR map as the persistent prior, including under severe illumination variations and dynamic occlusions.

摘要（中文）：在先前LiDAR地图中进行相机定位，为长期机器人导航提供了持久的几何参考，但由于相机图像与点云地图之间存在显著的模态差异，这一任务仍具挑战性。我们提出了一种统一定位框架，使LiDAR地图具备视觉可寻址性，而无需依赖专用的图像-LiDAR对应模型。地图几何与反射率被渲染为源自LiDAR的准图像，并带有明确的二维-三维来源信息，从而使相机观测与渲染地图视图能够共享成熟的视觉特征和匹配器，用于全局定位与连续位姿跟踪。通过这一通用视觉接口建立点与线对应关系，同时保留的来源信息恢复度量LiDAR几何以及由线支撑的平面约束，以进行位姿估计。为提升在模糊关联和弱几何条件下的鲁棒性，我们进一步引入了一种分布感知、可观测性互补的优化策略。该策略并非将匹配模糊性简化为标量置信度，而是将候选关联分布传播为方向性位姿信息不确定性，并根据结构因子对当前薄弱位姿方向的互补能力，选择性地增强可靠结构因子。在EuRoC MAV基准数据集及自采真实世界序列上的实验表明，仅使用预构建LiDAR地图作为持久先验，即可实现精确的全局定位和鲁棒的连续六自由度跟踪，即使在严重光照变化和动态遮挡条件下亦然。

Authors: Wentao Zhao, Zikun Chen, Yihe Niu, Haoyu Chen, Jingchuan Wang

A Sample-Based Approach for Hierarchical Information-Theoretic Compression of Probabilistic Occupancy Grids Perception3D

probabilistic occupancy grids hierarchical compression information theory Monte Carlo Tree Search sample-based

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于采样、受蒙特卡洛树搜索启发的分层信息论概率占用栅格压缩方法，相比穷举Q-tree搜索更快、更适合大规模机器人应用。

TLDR: This paper introduces a sample-based, MCTS-inspired method for hierarchical information-theoretic compression of probabilistic occupancy grids, which is faster and more scalable than exhaustive Q-tree search for robotics applications.

Abstract: We develop a sample-based framework for constructing information-driven hierarchical multi-resolution representations of probabilistic occupancy grids. Recent methods compute information-optimal abstractions via dynamic-programming-based exhaustive recursions, which become computationally prohibitive for large-scale grids and are ill-suited to robotics applications. To address this limitation, we introduce a sample-based strategy inspired by Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) that incrementally constructs hierarchical abstractions through statistical estimation rather than exhaustive enumeration. The proposed method is anytime in nature, allowing computation to be terminated at any stage to produce a valid compressed representation. We compare our approach with the information-optimal Q-tree search algorithm and demonstrate its effectiveness in rapidly generating abstractions of large real-world probabilistic occupancy grids.

摘要（中文）：我们构建了一种基于样本的框架，用于生成概率占用网格的信息驱动型分层多分辨率表示。现有方法通过基于动态规划的穷举递归计算信息最优抽象，但在大规模网格上计算开销巨大，难以适应机器人应用需求。为解决此局限，我们提出一种受蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）启发的基于样本的策略，通过统计估计而非穷举枚举来逐步构建分层抽象。该方法具有任意时间特性，可在任意阶段终止计算，并生成有效的压缩表示。我们将所提方法与信息最优Q树搜索算法进行对比，验证了其在大规模真实世界概率占用网格上快速生成抽象表示的有效性。

Authors: Zhenyu Jin, Daniel T. Larsson

Turning Safety into Competence: Minimally Exploitable Robot Policies via Safety-Filtered Reinforcement Learning RLRobot

Safety Filter Reinforcement Learning Markov Games Adversarial RL Competitive Tasks

简要说明：本文提出S2C，一种两阶段强化学习框架，通过对抗性RL学习鲁棒安全过滤器并在任务策略训练中嵌入环境，将安全合成与竞争任务学习分离，在模拟触地得分游戏和硬件压力测试中展示了更高的胜率、Elo评分和更低的利用度。

TLDR: This paper introduces S2C, a two-stage RL framework that separates safety synthesis from competitive task learning by learning a robust safety filter via adversarial RL and embedding it in the environment during task policy training, demonstrating improved win rate, Elo rating, and lower exploitability in simulated touchdown games and hardware stress tests.

Abstract: Robots deployed for competitive tasks must outmaneuver their opponents without sacrificing safety. Existing approaches, including safe reinforcement learning (RL), train a single policy to achieve task success and avoid failures simultaneously. This coupling can complicate training and leave the learned policy exploitable by deliberate attacks. We propose Safety to Competence (S2C), a two-stage RL framework that separates safety synthesis from competitive task learning. We formulate competitive interactions as safety-critical Markov games and prove that perfect filtering preserves policy non-exploitability when all players commit to safe maneuvers. S2C learns a robust safety filter via adversarial RL, embeds it in the environment during task policy training, and retains the same filter at deployment. In simulated touchdown games, S2C outperforms eight safe RL baselines, achieving the highest win rate and Elo rating, and the lowest exploitability. Hardware stress tests against a human opponent confirm S2C's competence.

摘要（中文）：为竞争性任务部署的机器人必须在确保安全的同时超越对手。现有方法，包括安全强化学习，训练单一策略以同时实现任务成功和避免失败。这种耦合可能使训练复杂化，并使所学策略易于受到蓄意攻击的利用。我们提出“安全到能力”（S2C），一种两阶段强化学习框架，将安全合成与竞争性任务学习分离。我们将竞争性交互形式化为安全关键的马尔可夫博弈，并证明当所有参与者致力于安全操动时，完美过滤能保持策略的不可利用性。S2C通过对抗性强化学习学习一个稳健的安全过滤器，在任务策略训练期间将其嵌入环境中，并在部署时保留同一过滤器。在模拟触地得分游戏中，S2C超越了八种安全强化学习基线，实现了最高的胜率和Elo评级，以及最低的可利用性。针对人类对手的硬件压力测试证实了S2C的能力。

Authors: Ruihan Wu, Rui Yang, Donggeon David Oh, Duy Nguyen, Haimin Hu

NaviScale: Generating Large-Scale Semantic Map Datasets for Object Navigation Other

ObjectNav semantic maps data generation floorplans ray casting

简要说明：NaviScale通过组合真实楼层平面图与房间级语义和障碍物地图，生成大规模语义地图数据集用于目标导航，在不改变预测架构的情况下提高了HM3D和MP3D上的ObjectNav性能。

TLDR: NaviScale generates large-scale semantic map datasets for object navigation by composing real floorplans with room-level semantic and obstacle maps, improving ObjectNav performance on HM3D and MP3D without changing the prediction architecture.

Abstract: Embodied navigation requires spatial representations that generalize across unseen environments, yet collecting large amounts of annotated data from real 3D environments is difficult. We propose NaviScale for semantic-map-based object navigation (ObjectNav), whose predictor can be trained on pairs of partial and complete semantic maps without reconstructing a complete 3D environment for every training sample. The framework generates large-scale semantic map training data by composing floorplans of real homes with room-level semantic and obstacle maps extracted from MP3D and HM3DSem. NaviScale increases data diversity in two ways: inter-room scaling increases floorplan-level structural diversity, while intra-room scaling fills each fixed floorplan with different combinations of room maps matched by room category. Visibility through Ray Casting (VisRC) converts the composed maps into partial observations that account for field of view, sensing range, and occlusion. The resulting dataset contains 192,000 semantic maps generated from 24,000 floorplans associated with 12,794 properties. With 300k training iterations and the training and inference settings described in this paper, the system reaches 64.3% SR and 34.8% SPL on HM3D, together with 43.1% SR and 16.8% SPL on MP3D, without changing the prediction architecture. Additional experiments evaluate the quality of the composed maps, the effects of semantic-segmentation errors, and deployment on a physical robot.

摘要（中文）：具身导航需要能够泛化到未见环境的空间表示，然而从真实三维环境中收集大量带标注数据十分困难。我们提出NaviScale，一种基于语义地图的物体导航（ObjectNav）框架，其预测器可以在不针对每个训练样本重建完整三维环境的情况下，利用部分语义地图与完整语义地图的配对进行训练。该框架通过将真实住宅的平面图与从MP3D和HM3DSem中提取的房间级语义及障碍物地图进行组合，生成大规模语义地图训练数据。NaviScale通过两种方式提升数据多样性：房间间缩放增加了平面图层面的结构多样性，而房间内缩放则通过按房间类别匹配的不同房间地图组合来填充每个固定平面图。基于射线投射的可见性计算（VisRC）将组合后的地图转换为考虑视野、感知范围和遮挡情况的部分观测。由此生成的数据集包含192,000张语义地图，源自24,000个平面图，关联12,794个房产。在300k次训练迭代以及本文所述的训练和推理设置下，该系统在HM3D上达到64.3%的成功率（SR）和34.8%的路径长度加权成功率（SPL），在MP3D上达到43.1%的SR和16.8%的SPL，且无需改变预测架构。额外实验评估了组合地图的质量、语义分割误差的影响以及在实际机器人上的部署情况。

Authors: Chuanlin Lan, Yanwei Zheng, Weijian Liu, Zhitong Zhou, Xiao Zhang, Fuzhen Zhuang, Dongxiao Yu

HINT-Blimp: Human INTent Inference from Multimodal Cues for Robotic Blimps Other

human intent inference multimodal cues particle filter robotic blimp linear dynamical system

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于机器人飞艇的人机交互框架，通过粒子滤波从稀疏多模态线索（推力和语音命令）推断人类意图，估计参数化线性动态系统，实现直观导航并避开人类已知障碍物。

TLDR: This paper introduces a human-robot interaction framework for robotic blimps where human intent is inferred from sparse multimodal cues (pushes and voice commands) using particle filters that estimate a parameterized linear dynamical system, enabling intuitive navigation around human-known obstacles.

Abstract: In human-robot interaction, traditional interfaces such as joysticks and handheld tablets introduce latency into navigation tasks and require the operator's explicit attention on the device, instead of the robot. We propose a new human-robot interaction framework in which a human communicates intent directly through sparse multimodal signals such as physical pushes and spoken commands. Human intent is represented as a parameterized linear dynamical system (LDS) that encodes the desired goal and motion behavior. The robot estimates this intent (parameters) online using a particle filter, where each particle represents a candidate LDS hypothesis and is reweighted online as new information becomes available. We validate this framework on a robotic blimp, whose inherent compliance and collision tolerance make it well-suited for repeated physical interaction. Experiments with multiple participants across 300 trials show that combining pushes and voice commands identifies the intended goal in 86% of trials within at most five interactions, with most trials resolved in two. The inferred dynamical systems can also produce curved trajectories that avoid obstacles known only to the human.

摘要（中文）：在人与机器人交互中，传统界面如操纵杆和手持平板电脑会给导航任务带来延迟，并要求操作者将明确注意力集中在设备上，而非机器人本身。我们提出了一种新型的人机交互框架，其中人类通过稀疏的多模态信号（如物理推挤和语音命令）直接传达意图。人类意图被表示为编码期望目标与运动行为的参数化线性动态系统（LDS）。机器人利用粒子滤波器在线估计这一意图（参数），其中每个粒子代表一个候选的LDS假设，并随着新信息的获取在线重新加权。我们在一种机器人飞艇上验证了该框架，其固有的柔顺性和碰撞容忍性使其非常适合重复的物理交互。涉及多名参与者的300次试验实验表明，结合推挤与语音命令能在最多五次交互内于86%的试验中识别出预期目标，且大多数试验在两次内即得到解决。推断出的动态系统还能生成弯曲轨迹，以避开仅人类知晓的障碍物。

Authors: Subhadeep Koley, Benjamin Greenberg, Yifei Simon Shao, Juan Aceros, Nadia Figueroa, David Saldaña

Planning Trajectories that Bounce: Reflection Classes for Collision-Tolerant Robots Locomotion

motion planning contact-aware control reflection-augmented state graph collision-tolerant navigation sampling-based controller

简要说明：本文提出一种移动机器人导航规划方法，通过主动利用受控墙壁反射生成可碰撞容错轨迹，相比纯无碰撞路径可减少执行时间和控制代价。

TLDR: This paper introduces a navigation planning method for mobile robots that deliberately uses controlled wall reflections to generate collision-tolerant trajectories, reducing execution time and control effort compared to purely collision-free paths.

Abstract: Robot navigation methods tend to avoid contact, and consequently search for collision-free trajectories. For robots with high inertia and limited maneuverability, however, avoiding contact can require substantial steering effort and time, even when interactions with surrounding surfaces could be safely exploited. In this paper, we develop a planning method that deliberately uses controlled wall reflections to generate trajectories that can be easier and more efficient to execute than purely collision-free motion. We consider planar navigation in environments where a mobile robot is permitted to bounce off surrounding surfaces. To represent the resulting alternatives, we construct a reflection-augmented state graph in which paths are partitioned into distinct classes according to the sequence of walls used for reflection. This representation enables systematic enumeration of reflection strategies and identification of the lowest-cost path within each class. We show that, although a reflecting path cannot be shorter than the shortest collision-free path, it can reduce execution time and actuation effort by replacing costly changes in heading with controlled environmental interactions. The planned trajectories are executed using a contact-aware sampling-based controller with the robot's full dynamics. In our experiments, we demonstrate that in our simulated test scenario, the best reflecting class can reduce time and control effort. Our results show that controlled contact can provide dynamically advantageous navigation strategies that are excluded by conventional collision-avoidance formulations.

摘要（中文）：机器人导航方法往往倾向于避免接触，因此会搜索无碰撞轨迹。然而，对于具有高惯性和有限机动性的机器人而言，即使周围表面的相互作用可以被安全利用，避免接触仍可能耗费大量转向力和时间。在本文中，我们开发了一种规划方法，该方法有意利用受控的墙面反射来生成轨迹，这些轨迹可能比纯无碰撞运动更易执行且更高效。我们考虑在允许移动机器人与周围表面发生反弹的环境中进行平面导航。为了表示由此产生的替代方案，我们构建了一个反射增强状态图，其中路径根据用于反射的墙面序列被划分为不同的类别。这种表示方式使得系统性地枚举反射策略并识别每个类别中成本最低的路径成为可能。我们表明，尽管反射路径不可能比最短无碰撞路径更短，但它可以通过用受控的环境交互替代昂贵的航向变化来减少执行时间和驱动能耗。规划的轨迹使用基于接触的采样控制器并结合机器人完整动力学进行执行。在我们的实验中，我们证明了在模拟测试场景中，最佳反射类别能够减少时间和控制能耗。我们的结果表明，受控接触能够提供动态上有利的导航策略，而这些策略在传统的避碰框架中是被排除的。

Authors: Subhadeep Koley, Subhrajit Bhattacharya, David Saldaña

Fast Direction-Conditioned Reachability for Motion Prediction Under Model Uncertainty Other

reachability analysis model uncertainty motion prediction collision avoidance closed-loop simulation

简要说明：本文提出了一种针对模型不确定的线性系统的快速方向条件可达性方法，并在多车辆闭环仿真中用于避碰。

TLDR: This paper introduces a fast direction-conditioned reachability method for linear systems with model uncertainty, which is used in a multi-vehicle closed-loop simulation for collision avoidance.

Abstract: To avoid collisions, a robot must repeatedly predict where nearby agents may move, usually with an imperfect model of their dynamics. Reachable sets provide such predictions, but computing them when the system matrices themselves are uncertain can become computationally expensive and conservative for frequent replanning. Moreover, a planner often needs to know only how far an agent can move in one particular direction, for example toward the robot, rather than the complete reachable set. We propose a direction-conditioned reachability method for linear systems with uncertain state and input matrices. Given a query direction $d$, the method selects one admissible model $(A^\star,B^\star)$ whose reachable set extends nearly as far along $d$ as the reachable set of the entire uncertain model family, and then computes the reachable set of only this model with a standard reachability solver. On an uncertain linearized bicycle model, the complete selection-and-computation pipeline is about three times faster than computing the reachable set of the full uncertain family in the CORA toolbox, while its extent along $d$ is within $5\%$ of the full family's in the reported directions. We also use the method in a closed-loop multi-vehicle simulation in which the robot queries, at each replanning step, how far each nearby vehicle can move toward it, and replans to avoid the resulting sets.

摘要（中文）：为避免碰撞，机器人必须反复预测附近代理可能移动的位置，通常依据其动力学的非完美模型。可达集提供了此类预测，但当系统矩阵本身不确定时，计算这些集合在频繁重新规划的情况下可能变得计算成本高昂且过于保守。此外，规划器往往只需知道代理在某一特定方向上（例如朝向机器人）能移动多远，而非完整的可达集。 我们提出了一种针对具有不确定状态矩阵和输入矩阵的线性系统的方向条件可达性方法。给定查询方向$d$，该方法选择一个可接受模型$(A^\star,B^\star)$，其可达集沿$d$方向的延伸几乎与整个不确定模型族的可达集一样远，然后仅使用标准可达性求解器计算该模型的可达集。在一个不确定的线性化自行车模型上，完整的“选择与计算”流程比在CORA工具箱中计算完整不确定族的可达集快约三倍，同时在所报告的方向上，其沿$d$方向的延伸范围在完整族的$5\%$以内。我们还在一个闭环多车辆仿真中使用了该方法，在该仿真中，机器人在每次重新规划步骤查询每辆邻近车辆能朝它移动多远，并重新规划以避免产生相应集合。

Authors: Hrishav Das, Melkior Ornik

Bend the Clock: Predicting Ahead to Beat Latency in Event-Based Object Detection Perception3D

event-based object detection latency cross-time fusion availability-time prediction autonomous driving

简要说明：ChronoFuse 提出了一种因果可用性时间的事件目标检测器，在输出时刻而非观测时刻预测目标状态，在高速驾驶和无人机飞行等机器人场景中恢复了大部分由延迟导致的精度损失。

TLDR: ChronoFuse introduces a causal availability-time event-based object detector that predicts object states at output time rather than observation time, recovering most latency-induced accuracy loss in high-speed robotic scenarios such as driving and drone flight.

Abstract: Event cameras promise low-latency perception for high-speed robotic systems, where even short delays can render detections stale by the time they inform downstream robotic decisions. Yet modern event detectors still require tens of milliseconds of computation before their predictions become available. Conventional evaluation ignores this delay by comparing predictions with annotations at the observation timestamp, even though the scene may have changed by the time those predictions are produced. We study this observation-availability mismatch in event-based multi-object detection and show that state-of-the-art event detectors degrade substantially when evaluated at prediction availability rather than observation time. To address this, we introduce ChronoFuse, a causal availability-time detector that predicts object states for when its output becomes available rather than for when its input was observed. ChronoFuse performs causal cross-time fusion over a multi-scale feature hierarchy, combining current representations with cached temporal features to expose short-term temporal cues without using future observations. The fusion pathway is lightweight, adding only 0.17 million parameters and 0.84 ms of mean end-to-end latency overhead. ChronoFuse recovers 71% of the accuracy lost to latency on 1Mpx driving data and 90.8% under rapid drone motion on FRED, nearly restoring zero-delay performance. Under the extreme motion of EV-Flying, ChronoFuse reaches 20.95 sAP, compared with 2.25 for the strongest standard event detector (9.3x gain). These results show that predicting ahead can be critical for robots operating in fast-changing scenes, including autonomous driving, agile flight, and robotic interception.

摘要（中文）：事件相机为高速机器人系统带来了低延迟感知的承诺，在这些系统中，即便是短暂的延迟也可能使检测结果在下游机器人决策接收到时已然过时。然而，现代事件检测器仍需数十毫秒的计算时间才能产生预测结果。传统评估方法忽略了这一延迟，将预测结果与观测时间戳下的标注进行比较，尽管在预测生成时场景可能已经发生变化。我们研究了基于事件的多目标检测中这一观测与可用性不匹配的问题，并表明当在预测可用时间而非观测时间进行评估时，最先进的事件检测器性能显著下降。为解决这一问题，我们提出了ChronoFuse，一种因果可用性时间检测器，它预测的是输出可用时刻的对象状态，而非输入被观测时刻的状态。ChronoFuse在多尺度特征层级上执行因果跨时间融合，将当前表示与缓存的时序特征相结合，在不使用未来观测的情况下揭示短期时间线索。该融合路径轻量高效，仅增加0.17百万参数和0.84毫秒的平均端到端延迟开销。ChronoFuse恢复了1Mpx驾驶数据中因延迟而损失的71%精度，在FRED数据集上的快速无人机运动场景中恢复了90.8%，几乎达到了零延迟性能水平。在EV-Flying的极端运动条件下，ChronoFuse达到20.95的sAP，而最强标准事件检测器仅为2.25（增益达9.3倍）。这些结果表明，对于在快速变化场景中运行的机器人系统（包括自动驾驶、敏捷飞行和机器人拦截），前瞻性预测可能至关重要。

Authors: Biswadeep Sen, Benoit R. Cottereau, Nicolas Cuperlier, Terence Sim

Breaking Weather-Content Coupling: Type-Severity Guided Progressive Disentanglement for All-in-One Infrared Restoration Perception3D

infrared restoration adverse weather progressive disentanglement degradation severity autonomous driving

简要说明：TSGPD-IR 提出了一种类型-严重程度引导的渐进式解耦网络，用于全场景红外图像恢复，明确针对自动驾驶感知中的天气伪影。该方法将恢复分解为全局天气语义提示与空间变化的退化严重程度先验，通过分层专家选择在保留真实热结构的同时抑制伪天气响应。

TLDR: TSGPD-IR proposes a type-severity guided progressive disentanglement network for all-in-one infrared image restoration, explicitly targeting weather-induced artifacts in autonomous driving perception. It factorizes restoration into global weather semantic prompts and spatially varying degradation severity priors, using hierarchical expert selection to preserve intrinsic thermal structures while suppressing fake weather responses.

Abstract: Infrared (IR) imaging is crucial for autonomous driving, remote sensing, and other perception tasks. However, adverse weather may introduce fake structural responses that are entangled with real thermal structures. Existing IR restoration methods are typically designed for a single degradation type or directly reconstruct from degradation-entangled representations. Consequently, they struggle to distinguish intrinsic thermal structures from weather-induced fake responses and to accommodate spatially varying degradation severity, leading to artifacts or the over-suppression of weak but meaningful thermal responses. To address these issues, we propose TSGPD-IR, a type-severity guided progressive disentanglement network for all-in-one infrared restoration that factorizes restoration guidance into task-level weather semantics and region-level degradation severity. Specifically, a Weather and Semantic Co-Guided Multi-Level Prompt Generation Module combines global weather semantics with stage-wise local features to generate adaptive prompts that progressively suppress degradation-induced responses while preserving intrinsic thermal structures. To complement global weather semantics with spatial restoration control, a Proxy-Supervised Regional Degradation Estimator derives severity supervision without manual annotations and predicts spatially varying degradation priors. Guided by these cues, a Multi-Source Collaborative Expert Selection Strategy uses a shared branch to preserve weather-invariant thermal structures and hierarchical routing to select weather-specific expert pools and severity-compatible regional experts. This design progressively separates degradation interference from genuine thermal content and enables region-adaptive restoration, reducing both residual artifacts and over-suppression.

摘要（中文）：红外（IR）成像对于自动驾驶、遥感及其他感知任务至关重要。然而，恶劣天气可能引入与真实热结构纠缠在一起的虚假结构响应。现有的红外恢复方法通常针对单一退化类型设计，或直接从退化纠缠的表示中进行重建。因此，它们难以区分内在热结构与天气引起的虚假响应，也难以适应空间变化的退化严重程度，导致出现伪影或对微弱但有意义的热响应产生过度抑制。为解决这些问题，我们提出TSGPD-IR，一种类型-严重程度引导的渐进式解缠网络，用于一体化红外恢复，将恢复引导分解为任务级天气语义和区域级退化严重程度。具体而言，天气与语义协同引导的多级提示生成模块将全局天气语义与逐阶段局部特征相结合，生成自适应提示，在保留内在热结构的同时逐步抑制退化引起的响应。为以空间恢复控制补充全局天气语义，代理监督的区域退化估计器无需人工标注即可推导严重程度监督，并预测空间变化的退化先验。在这些线索的引导下，多源协同专家选择策略利用共享分支保留天气不变的热结构，并通过层次路由选择天气特定的专家池和严重程度兼容的区域专家。该设计逐步将退化干扰与真实热内容分离，实现区域自适应恢复，同时减少残留伪影和过度抑制。

Authors: Xinyao Wang, Lijun He, Zhihan Ren, Fan Li

Listening and Mirroring: The Effects of Verbal Attunement and Behavioral Mimicry on Social and Empathic Perceptions of Embodied AI Agents in VR Other

embodied AI virtual reality verbal attunement behavioral mimicry empathy perception

简要说明：本文研究了VR中具身AI咨询师的言语调谐和行为模仿对用户社交和共情感知的影响，发现言语调谐是感知共情的主要驱动因素，而行为模仿对人性化感知的影响较弱。

TLDR: This paper studies the effects of verbal attunement and behavioral mimicry on users' social and empathic perceptions of an embodied AI counselor in VR, finding that verbal attunement drives perceived empathy while behavioral mimicry has marginal effects on humanness.

Abstract: As embodied agents take on increasingly social and relational roles in VR, visual realism and embodiment alone may be insufficient; users must also perceive these agents as emotionally attuned, supportive, and humanlike. Prior work suggests that verbal attunement and nonverbal mimicry can each improve users' social evaluations of embodied agents. However, behavioral mimicry has largely been studied outside of real-time, conversational AI interactions, leaving limited understanding of how users respond when an agent simultaneously generates contextually responsive dialogue and adapts its nonverbal behavior during an immersive conversation. To address this gap, we developed an embodied AI counselor that combines conversational AI with real-time facial-expression and posture mimicry, while producing either verbally attuned or neutral responses. We evaluated the system in a 2 X 2 within-subjects study with 20 participants, manipulating verbal attunement and behavioral mimicry. Results showed that verbal attunement was the most reliable driver of perceived empathy. Behavioral mimicry showed a marginal relationship with perceived humanness, while greater mimicry exposure showed preliminary, exploratory positive associations with empathy, positivity, and humanness, particularly among female participants. Together, these findings show that multimodal synchrony is not a simple additive strategy for designing empathic conversational agents in VR and underscore the need to consider how verbal and nonverbal behaviors are combined during real-time interaction.

摘要（中文）：随着具身智能体在虚拟现实（VR）中承担越来越多的社交与关系型角色，仅靠视觉真实感和具身化可能已不足够；用户还必须感知到这些智能体在情感上契合、提供支持且具有类人特质。以往研究表明，言语调和与非言语模仿均能分别改善用户对具身智能体的社会评价。然而，行为模仿的研究大多未涉及实时的对话式人工智能交互场景，导致对于智能体在沉浸式对话中同时生成情境化响应话语并调整其非言语行为时用户的反应，现有理解仍十分有限。为弥补这一空白，我们开发了一款具身AI咨询师，它将对话式人工智能与实时面部表情和姿态模仿相结合，同时生成言语上契合或中性的回应。我们采用2×2被试内设计，对20名参与者进行了系统评估，操纵了言语调和与行为模仿两个变量。结果表明，言语调和是感知共情最可靠的驱动因素。行为模仿与感知类人性呈边缘显著相关，而更多的模仿暴露则显示出与共情、积极性和类人性初步的探索性正相关，尤其是在女性参与者中尤为明显。综上，这些发现表明，多模态同步并非在VR中设计具有共情能力的对话智能体的简单叠加策略，并强调了在实时交互过程中考虑言语与非言语行为如何结合的必要性。
